programme.title: Asked - hunted / Gefragt - Gejagt
programme.desc: In the quiz show, a team of four candidates competes against the "Jager". This is not an easy task, because the "Jagers" are proven quiz professionals from the German quiz national team, including even the German quizmaster. In the first round, the candidates set up a game sum individually, which they have to defend together against the "Jager" in the second round to move into the final. In the final, the remaining candidates in the team compete against the "Jager" and defend the money earned so far. You have to answer as many questions as possible within two minutes. If the candidates answer more questions than the "Jager", they won. / In der Quizsendung tritt ein Team von vier Kandidaten gegen den "Jager" an. Dies ist keine leichte Aufgabe, denn die "Jager" sind ausgewiesene Quizprofis aus der deutschen Quiznationalmannschaft, darunter sogar der Deutsche Quizmaster. In der ersten Runde bauen die Kandidaten einzeln eine Spielsumme auf, die sie in der zweiten Runde gemeinsam gegen den "Jager" verteidigen mussen, um in das Finale einzuziehen. Im Finale treten die verbliebenen Kandidaten im Team gegen den "Jager" an und verteidigen das bisher erspielte Geld. Sie mussen innerhalb von zwei Minuten so viele Fragen wie moglich beantworten. Beantworten die Kandidaten mehr Fragen als der "Jager" richtig, haben sie gewonnen.

programme.desc: Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Er hat ein fotografisches Gedachtnis und kann selbst aus kleinsten Hinweisen eine Spur basteln. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. Mit der Hilfe seines ehemaligen Chefs Captain Leland Stottlemeyer sowie seiner personlicher Assistentin Sharona Fleming lost Monk seitdem die Kriminalfalle, die sonst niemand losen kann.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Dr. Leonard Lakey Hofstadter and Dr. Sheldon Cooper are brilliant physicists, work in the same institute and share an apartment. In contrast, Sheldon in particular has its difficulties in dealing with the social environment. To your circle of friends, Dr. Rajesh Ramayan Kothrappali and the engineer Howard Wolowitz. When the Hubsche Penny moves into the apartment next door, she can not first do much with the merky scientists who prefer to spend their free time in the comic bookshop and Halo or World of Warcraft. After a while, however, the group wakes her heart. / Dr. Leonard Leakey Hofstadter und Dr. Sheldon Cooper sind geniale Physiker, arbeiten im selben Institut und teilen sich eine Wohnung. Im Umgang mit der sozialen Umwelt hingegen hat vor allem Sheldon seine Schwierigkeiten. Zu ihrem Freundeskreis gehoren Dr. Rajesh Ramayan Koothrappali und der Ingenieur Howard Wolowitz. Als die hubsche Penny in die Wohnung nebenan einzieht, kann sie zunachst nicht viel mit den merkwurdigen Wissenschaftlern, die ihre Freizeit am liebsten im Comicbuchladen und Halo oder World of Warcraft spielend verbringen, anfangen. Nach einer Weile wachst ihr die Gruppe aber ans Herz.

programme.title: Das Yoga-Magazin

programme.title: "We move Austria" school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: Funsport
programme.desc: Under the term "fun sport" trend and extreme sports are summarized, which mostly primarily deal with the fun factor. The high pressure to perform, which is Ugleich in normal sports, is more common here. There are winners, but no losers. programme.title: Motorsport: Sudsteiermark Classic
programme.desc: The drivers from all over the world take part in the classic car rally in the Sudstyrian Gamlitz. There are two categories. One is for the automobile by 1949, the other for the vehicles from 1950. You can see cars like Ford Model A from 1929. / Die Fahrer aus aller Welt nehmen an der Oldtimer-Rallye in dem sudsteirischen Gamlitz teil. Es gibt zwei Kategorien. Eine ist fur die Automobile bis Baujahr 1949, die andere fur die Fahrzeuge ab Baujahr 1950. Die Fahrer und Beifahrer unter dem vollendeten 35. Lebensjahr konnen den Next Generation Award erhalten. Zu sehen sind solche Wagen wie das Ford Modell A aus dem Jahr 1929.

programme.title: FudBal - Copa Libertadores / Fudbal - Copa Libertadores
programme.desc: The "Copa Libertadores" is the annual competition founded in 1960. year and the 38 best teams of South America occur. Throughout history, the format of the competition changed, of which only the champions in their leagions have the right to perform until today when each state gives a minimum of three representatives. The most successful club with the most won titles is Argentine's giant independence. Argentina also gave the most wins of Kope. The competition has iconic status and is considered one of the suburbs of soccer events on the planet. / "Copa Libertadores" je godišnje takmičenje osnovano 1960. godine te u njemu nastupa 38 najboljih ekipa Južne Amerike. Kroz istoriju format takmičenja se mijenjao, od toga da samo prvaci u svojim liga imaju pravo nastupa pa do danas kada svaka država daje po minimalno tri predstavnika. Najuspešniji klub sa najviše osvojenih titula je argentinski velikan Indipendijente. Argentina je dala i najviše osvajača Kope. Takmičenje ima ikonski status te se smatra jednim od nauzbudljivih fudbalskih događaja na planeti.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, a yearly continental competition in which only the champions of their states perform. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of its state. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga

programme.title: Handball: EHF Champions League / Rukomet: EHF Liga prvaka
programme.desc: Handball league Championships has since 1955. when the competition was founded under the name Cup Champions. We received the first winner in the 1956-1957 season. years, and that was the threshold team because only city selections were performed at that season. Today, that club is called Dukla Prague. Until 1993. The competition was held under that name and played according to the Cup system on the relegation. Since 1993. In addition to changing the name in the Champions League, the group phase of the competition was introduced after which the following are elimination. The group phase changed with age and is also introduced and FAINAL FOR FOR FOUR FOUR FROM EUROPE HANDMETICS AFTER that the champion was obtained. / Rukometna Liga prvaka svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. Prvog pobjednika smo dobili u sezoni 1956.-1957. godine, a to je bila ekipa Praga jer u toj sezoni su nastupale samo gradske selekcije. Danas se taj klub zove Dukla Prag. Sve do 1993. godine takmičenje se održalo pod tim nazivom i igralo se po kup sistemu na ispadanje. Od 1993. godine osim promene naziva u Ligu prvaka, uvedena je i grupna faza takmičenja nakon koje slede eliminacije. Grupna faza se sa godinama mijenjala te je uveden i Fajnal for za četiri najbolje rukometne ekipe Evrope nakon koje se dobija prvak.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, a yearly continental competition in which only the champions of their states perform. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of its state. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. programme.title: Football - French League / Fudbal - Francuska liga
programme.desc: Ligue 1 The first is the French professional football league that has 20 teams in the fight for the title of France champions. Najtrofejniji klub s deset osvojenih titula je AS Sent Etjen ali "Zeleni" na novu titulu čekaju još od davne 1981. godine i vremena velikog Mišela Platinija. Susreti francuske lige nezaobilazan su događaj za svakog ljubitelja ove veličanstvene igre.

programme.title: Boks
programme.desc: Rocky Marciano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Louis. Do you need another reason to follow this noble martial skill? We find the first boxes of boxes already in the third stand before Christ on Sumerian drawings. In the modern age, the first rules of boxes were established 18. century in London and define the space of the fight, equipment and illicit and permitted types of blows. Don't miss every opportunity to enjoy this exciting sport. / Rocky Marciano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Louis. Treba li još koji razlog više za pratiti ovu plemenitu borilačku vještinu? Prve prikaze boksa nalazimo već u trećem stojeću prije Krista na sumeranskim crtežima. Ne propustite svaku priliku za uživati u ovom uzbudljivom sportu.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Cycling: A Czech Tour / Колоездене: Обиколка на Чехия
programme.desc: The Sazka Tour is one of the most famous cycling competitions in the Czech Republic, which is usually held every year in the summer and attracts participants from all over the world. The event is part of the UCI Europe Tour, which makes it meaningful for professional cyclists, as well as for lovers who want to test their skills in this picturesque country. / "Sazka Tour" е едно от най-известните колоездачни състезания в Чехия, което обикновено се провежда всяка година през лятото и привлича участници от цял свят. Събитието е част от UCI Europe Tour, което го прави значимо за професионалните колоездачи, както и за любителите, които искат да изпитат своите умения в тази живописна страна.

programme.desc: The World Classical and Free Wrestling Championship is organized by United World Wrestling (UWW). Световните надпревари по класическа борба стартират от 1904 година, а по свободна борба от 1951 година.

programme.title: Athletics: World Cup in Tokyo / Лека атлетика: Световно първенство в Токио
programme.desc: The best competitors in the Queen of Sports gather in Tokyo. 2200 athletes, representatives of 198 countries, will start in the Japanese capital in the first major outdoor championship from the new Olympic cycle. Rising stars and well-established characters will fight for the 49 sets of medals that will be distributed in Tokyo. The hosts of the championship and world athletics have taken into account the program so that all the most interesting disciplines are at a convenient time to watch in Europe. Bulgaria will be represented by its four best competitors. The European champion in a hall in the length of Bozhidar Saraboyukov will fight for a place among the best in the discipline. 10 years after her fourth place in Beijing, Gabriela Petrova will try to rank among the finalists on a triple jump. Plamen Mitkova in the length of length will again look for her place among the world elite after the fourth position of the World Championship in the hall in March. Tihomir Ivanov strives for the second consecutive planetary level after the eighth place last year at the Olympic Games in Paris. / Най-добрите състезатели в Царицата на спортовете се събират в Токио. 2200 лекоатлети, представители на 198 страни, ще стартират в японската столица в първия голям шампионат на открито от новия олимпийски цикъл. Изгряващи звезди и утвърдени герои ще влязат в борба за 49-те комплекта медали, които ще се разпределят в Токио. Домакините на шампионата и Световната атлетика са съобразили програмата така, че всички най-интересни дисциплини да бъдат в удобно за гледане в Европа време. България ще бъде представена от четиримата си най-добри състезатели. Европейският шампион в зала в скока на дължина Божидар Саръбоюков ще се бори за място сред най-добрите в дисциплината. 10 години след четвъртото си място в Пекин, Габриела Петрова ще се опита да се нареди сред финалистките на троен скок. Пламена Миткова в скока на дължина отново ще търси своето място сред световния елит след четвъртата позиция на световния шампионат в зала през март. Тихомир Иванов се стреми към втори пореден финал на планетарно ниво след осмото място през миналата година на Олимпийските игри в Париж.

programme.title: The latter wins / Последният печели
programme.desc: "The Last Win" is a fun-cognitive, family quiz show involving four players. It consists of three rounds with different spheres of knowledge, in which the questions are of different point value. After the end of each round, one participant drops out, and the winner wins the right to compete in the next episode and plays until someone else is able to beat him. / "Последният печели" е забавно-познавателно, семейно куиз шоу, в което участват четирима играчи. Състои се от три кръга с различни сфери на познанието, в които въпросите са с различна точкова стойност. След края на всеки кръг отпада по един участник, а победителят печели правото да се състезава и в следващия епизод и играе, докато някой друг не успее да го победи.

programme.title: The Mysteries of Dr. Blake / Мистериите на доктор Блейк
programme.desc: During a Scout camp, one of the executives was found dead. Jean is trying to help in the investigation, despite the skeptical remarks that she is not like Dr. Blake. / По време на скаутски лагер единият от ръководителите е намерен мъртъв. Джийн се опитва да помага в разследването, въпреки скептичните забележки, че тя не е като доктор Блейк.

programme.title: Fight: World Cup: Women, Finals / Борба: Световно първенство: Жени, финали
programme.desc: Bulgaria will be represented by 14 competitors. The first free -style participants will be released on the Tepeha, who will distribute medals in the days from September 14 to 16. Seven will be the Bulgarian fighters - Ivaylo Tisov /57 kg /, Mikya Naim /65 kg /, Mihail Georgiev /70 kg /, Ramadan Ramazanov /74 kg /, Ahmed Bataev /92 kg /, Ahmed Magamaev /97 kg /and Alen Hubulov /125 kg /. The women enter the battle for the honors from September 16 to September 18, with the Bulgarians will be 3 - Bilyana Dudova /62 kg /, Juliana Yaneva /68 kg /and Vanessa Georgieva /76 kg /. The last three days have been designated for the classical style categories, with four being there will be the Bulgarian representatives there - Nikolay Vichev /63 kg /, David Dimitrov /72 kg /, Stoyan Kubatov /77 kg /and Daniel Alexandrov /87 kg /. / България ще бъде представена от 14 състезатели. Първи на тепеха излизат участниците в свободния стил, които ще разпределят медалите в дните от 14 до 16 септември. Седем ще са българските борци – Ивайло Тисов /57 кг/, Микяй Наим /65 кг/, Михаил Георгиев /70 кг/, Рамазан Рамазанов /74 кг/, Ахмед Батаев /92 кг/, Ахмед Магамаев /97 кг/ и Ален Хубулов /125 кг/. Жените влизат в битка за отличията от 16 до 18 септември, като там българките ще бъдат 3 – Биляна Дудова /62 кг/, Юлияна Янева /68 кг/ и Ванеса Георгиева /76 кг/. Последните три дни са отредени за категориите в класическия стил, като четирима ще бъдат българските представители там – Николай Вичев /63 кг/, Дейвид Димитров /72 кг/, Стоян Кубатов /77 кг/ и Даниел Александров /87 кг/.

programme.desc: Jean and pathologist Lucy still manage to expose the culprit for the death of a scout leader. Although Jean suffers for Lucian Blake, he decides to move on. programme.title: Hall of Fame: Evulanda Slavcheva / Зала на славата: Евладия Славчева
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a section in which we present the most famous faces of the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, which, with their success over the years, have enjoyed sports lovers in our country. In the Hall of Glory, they tell about themselves - about successes, disappointments, difficulties, peaks, about the past and the present, about sports, which plays a huge role in life and for life after sports. Thanks to the rich archive of Bulgarian National Television, you will have the opportunity to see the biggest successes of the stars of Bulgarian sport. / "Зала на славата" е рубрика, в която представяме най-известните лица от голямата златна плеяда български спортисти. Тези значими имена, които със своите успехи през годините са радвали любителите на спорта в нашата страна. В "Зала на славата" те разказват за себе си - за успехите, разочарованията, трудностите, върховете, за миналото и настоящето, за спорта, който играе огромна роля в живота и за живота след спорта. Благодарение на богатия архив на Българската национална телевизия ще имате възможност да видите и най-големите успехи на звездите на българския спорт.

programme.title: Cycling: Tour of Germany / Колоездене: Обиколка на Германия
programme.desc: The tour of Germany is one of the largest and most prestigious cycling competitions in Germany. This is a multi -day race, which is usually held in late summer and attracts top cyclists from around the world. Germany is known for its beautiful and diverse routes that offer both flat stages and serious mountain climbs, which makes the competition extremely exciting and contested. / Обиколката на Германия е едно от най-големите и престижни състезания по колоездене в Германия. Това е многодневно състезание, което обикновено се провежда в края на лятото и привлича топ колоездачи от целия свят. Германия е известна със своите красиви и разнообразни маршрути, които предлагат както равнинни етапи, така и сериозни планински изкачвания, което прави състезанието изключително вълнуващо и оспорвано.

programme.title: Silence and Vic / Тишина и вик
programme.desc: In Hungary in 1919, after a short republic, "monarchy" was restored (without a monarch ...). "White Red Pursuit" begins ... Istvan Chershi is a former Red Army soldier of the Republic, who escapes and hides in the large Hungarian plain, finding a shelter in a rural farm, with two cute young women and a childhood friend, who is now a "commandant" of the local royal police unit. Istvan seems to be used to rural comfort as police cross the country, in search of former soldiers and sympathizers. One day, the militant soldier reveals that the two young women poison the legal owners of the farm - the mother -in -law and the wife. Then the running Istvan faces the dilemma between morality and survival - to keep silent about the actions of women and to save his life or to report their act, which will lead to his death. / В Унгария през 1919, след кратка република, е възстановена "монархия" (без монарх...). Започва "бяло преследване на червени"... Ищван Черши е бивш войник от червената армия на републиката, който бяга и се укрива в Голямата Унгарска равнина, намерил приют в селска ферма, при две симпатични млади жени и свой приятел от детството, който сега е "комендант" на местния "Кралски полицейски отряд". Ищван сякаш свиква в селския уют, докато полицията кръстосва страната, в търсене на бивши войници и симпатизанти. Един ден приютеният войник разкрива, че двете млади жени тровят законните собственици на фермата - свекървата и съпруга. Тогава бягащият Ищван е изправен пред дилема между морал и оцеляване - да запази мълчание за действията на жените и да спаси своя живот или да докладва за тяхното деяние, което ще доведе до неговата гибел.

programme.title: Athletics: World Cup in Tokyo / Лека атлетика: Световно първенство в Токио
programme.desc: The best competitors in the Queen of Sports gather in Tokyo. 2200 athletes, representatives of 198 countries, will start in the Japanese capital in the first major outdoor championship from the new Olympic cycle. Rising stars and well-established characters will fight for the 49 sets of medals that will be distributed in Tokyo. The hosts of the championship and world athletics have taken into account the program so that all the most interesting disciplines are at a convenient time to watch in Europe. Bulgaria will be represented by its four best competitors. The European champion in a hall in the length of Bozhidar Saraboyukov will fight for a place among the best in the discipline. 10 years after her fourth place in Beijing, Gabriela Petrova will try to rank among the finalists on a triple jump. Plamen Mitkova in the length of length will again look for her place among the world elite after the fourth position of the World Championship in the hall in March. Tihomir Ivanov strives for the second consecutive planetary level after the eighth place last year at the Olympic Games in Paris. / Най-добрите състезатели в Царицата на спортовете се събират в Токио. 2200 лекоатлети, представители на 198 страни, ще стартират в японската столица в първия голям шампионат на открито от новия олимпийски цикъл. Изгряващи звезди и утвърдени герои ще влязат в борба за 49-те комплекта медали, които ще се разпределят в Токио. Домакините на шампионата и Световната атлетика са съобразили програмата така, че всички най-интересни дисциплини да бъдат в удобно за гледане в Европа време. България ще бъде представена от четиримата си най-добри състезатели. Европейският шампион в зала в скока на дължина Божидар Саръбоюков ще се бори за място сред най-добрите в дисциплината. 10 години след четвъртото си място в Пекин, Габриела Петрова ще се опита да се нареди сред финалистките на троен скок. Пламена Миткова в скока на дължина отново ще търси своето място сред световния елит след четвъртата позиция на световния шампионат в зала през март. Тихомир Иванов се стреми към втори пореден финал на планетарно ниво след осмото място през миналата година на Олимпийските игри в Париж.

programme.title: Tourism.bg / Туризъм.бг
programme.desc: Weekly television broadcast dedicated to Bulgarian tourism. The team travels all over Bulgaria and promotes Bulgarian cities as attractive tourist destinations. Only in our show time stops and you can walk through the captivating and beautiful Bulgarian mountains, to conquer the highest native peaks, to take the steepest forest paths. Get to know us the most challenging tourist routes and immerse yourself in the past with the most exciting historical collections of Bulgaria. / Седмично телевизионно предаване, посветено на българския туризъм. Екипът пътува в цяла България и популяризира български градове като атрактивни туристически дестинации. Само в нашето предаване времето спира и можете да се разхождате из пленителните и красиви български планини, да покорите най-високите родни върхове, да превземете най-стръмните горски пътеки. Опознайте с нас най- предизвикателните туристически маршрути и се потопете в миналото с най-вълнуващите исторически сбирки на България.

programme.title: In the rhythm of the city / В ритъма на града
programme.desc: The show brings together the most interesting of worldly life. Topical topics from the world of show business, meetings with interesting young people, with followers on the nets will be awaited. programme.title: Nestala
programme.desc: Jill (Amanda Seyfried) returns home after a night shift and reveals that her sister Molly has been abducted. A year ago, Jill managed to escape the kidnapper and is convinced that the same serial killer returned to Molly. Since the killer has left no trace, the police have no evidence and cannot help her. Fearing that Molly would be dead before the morning, Jill goes on a standalone chase to face the killer. Will she have enough time to outsmart him, discover his secrets and save his sister? / Jill (Amanda Seyfried) se vraća kući nakon noćne smjene i otkriva da je njena sestra Molly oteta. Prije godinu dana Jill je uspjela pobjeći otmičaru i uvjerena je da se isti serijski ubojica vratio po Molly. Pošto ubojica nije ostavio nikakav trag, policija nema dokaza i ne može joj pomoći. Strahujući da će Molly biti mrtva prije jutra, Jill kreće u samostalnu potjeru kako bi se suočila s ubojicom.Da li će imati dovoljno vremena da ga nadmudri, otkrije njegove tajne i spasi sestru?

programme.title: Jocker
programme.desc: Nick Wild, a bodyguard and a dice addict, embarks on a vengeful march when his friend rapes a disturbed bully. But what Nick does not know is that the abuser is the son of a powerful mafia boss. The roles are now higher than ever because only one can survive this game. / Nick Wild, tjelohranitelj i ovisnik o kocki, kreće u osvetnički pohod kada njegovu prijateljicu siluje poremećeni nasilnik. No ono što Nick ne zna je da je zlostavljač sin moćnog mafijaškog šefa. Ulozi su sad viši nego ikada jer ovu igru može preživjeti samo jedan.

Worried that the police will not believe in an accident, they decide to hide the truth. / Jedne noći, nakon što otkrije da ga žena vara, Alexandre je slučajno ubije. Robbery in Hatton Garden / Pljačka u Hatton Gardenu
programme.desc: During one Easter weekend, we follow a mysterious man and four of the old London criminals eager for the last chance of glory as they plan and execute the biggest robbery in British history. / Tijekom jednog uskrsnog vikenda pratimo jednog tajanstvenog čovjeka i četvoricu ostarjelih londonskih kriminalaca željnih zadnje šanse za slavu dok planiraju i izvršavaju najveću pljačku u britanskoj povijesti.

programme.title: Skandalozno ponašanje
programme.desc: The Miss World Choice in 1970 was held in London and the presenter was American comedian Bob Hope. At that time it was the most watched TV show in the world, with more than 100 million spectators. By claiming that beauty competitions portray women as sexual objects, a new movement for the liberation of women overnight gained fame with fall on stage and interfere with the transmission of the choice. / Izbor za Miss svijeta 1970. održao se u Londonu, a voditelj je bio američki komičar Bob Hope. U ono je vrijeme to bio najgledaniji TV show na svijetu, s više od 100 milijuna gledatelja. Tvrdeći da natjecanja u ljepoti prikazuju žene kao seksualne objekte, novi pokret za oslobođenje žena preko noći je stekao slavu upadom na pozornicu i ometanjem prijenosa izbora.

programme.title: Ask me anything / Pitaj me bilo što
programme.desc: Beautiful, wild and a little lost, Katie Kampenfelt pauses the year before college to find himself. Records his adventures in an anonymous blog in which he reveals his inner secrets, and over time the dark parts of her past are inflamed to the surface. / Lijepa, divlja i pomalo izgubljena, Katie Kampenfelt pauzira godinu prije fakulteta da bi pronašla sebe. Bilježi svoje avanture u anonimnom blogu u kojem otkriva svoje unutrašnje tajne, a s vremenom mračni dijelovi njezine prošlosti isplivavaju na površinu.

programme.title: Dijete Ozirisa
programme.desc: The film is located at the time of the interplanetary colonization, where we meet Sya Lombroka, a former paramedic of a dark past running out of prison. He will make an unusual alliance with Kane Sommerville, a sergeant who works for the exor military company. In the race over time, the two of them will try to save Kane's daughter of Indi, and prevent a global crisis that could cause exor. / Film je smješten u vrijeme međuplanetarne kolonizacije, gdje upoznajemo Sya Lombroka, bivšeg bolničara mračne prošlosti koji bježi iz zatvora. On će sklopiti neobično savezništvo s Kaneom Sommervilleom, narednikom koji radi za vojnu kompaniju Exor. U trci s vremenom, njih dvojica će pokušati spasiti Kaneovu kći Indi, i spriječiti globalnu krizu koju bi mogao izazvati Exor.

programme.desc: Italian Serie A: Highlights - (Sport. Program, Italy) Serie A is a professional football competition that has 20 teams in the two -round league championship. For many years, Italian football was considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and coaches. With the fall of the financial power of the Italian first -team players and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality, but returns safe steps to the place where it belongs. ... / Italian Serie A: Highlights - (sport. program, Italija) Serie A profesionalno je nogometno natjecanje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Dugi niz godina talijanski se nogomet svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Europi. Padom financijske moći talijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada. ...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

The Cup was founded in 1992 under the authority of the Croatian Football Federation, and the first winner was an inker from Zapresic. A total of five teams won the Cup, and the most successful is Zagreb's Dinamo in front of Split Hajduk. In the final phase of the Cup, 48 teams compete, the 16 best clubs per coefficient, 21 winners of the county competitions and 11 defeated in the finals of the county competitions. The play is played on the playoffs on one game except the quarterfinals and the semifinals when two matches are played ... / Football - Croatian Cup - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025) Hrvatski kup najmasovnije je nogometno natjecanje u Hrvatskoj. Kup je osnovan 1992. godine pod ingerencijom Hrvatskog nogometnog saveza, a prvi osvajač bio je Inker iz Zaprešića. Ukupno pet momčadi osvajalo je kup, a najuspješniji je zagrebački Dinamo ispred splitskog Hajduka. U završnoj fazi kupa natječe se 48 momčadi, 16 najboljih klubova po koeficijentu, 21 pobjednik županijskih natjecanja te 11 poraženih u finalima županijskim natjecanjima. Igra se po principu doigravanja na jednu utakmicu izuzev četvrtfinala i polufinala kada se igraju dva susreta...

Irina (Luise Berndt), eine taubstumme Bettlerin, die sich mit dem Verkauf von Schlusselanhangern uber Wasser halt, wird Zeugin einer blutigen SchieSSerei. In dem Trubel stiehlt sie kurz entschlossen eine Mappe mit Dokumenten vom Tatort - und bringt sich damit in hochste Lebensgefahr. Die Unterlagen namlich konnen beweisen, dass der ebenso einflussreiche wie skrupellose Salvio Giustina (Hanns Zischler) im Zweiten Weltkrieg ein Nazi-Kollaborateur war. Giustina ist entschlossen, die Veroffentlichung der Dokumente um jeden Preis zu verhindern. Wahrend der Unterweltkonig Drakic (Christopher Buchholz), der Giustina mit den Akten erpressen will, die junge Gangsterin Branka (Inga Busch) beauftragt, Irina und die Mappe zu finden, bekommt Commissario Laurenti (Henry Hubchen) die Macht des alten Patriarchen zu spuren: Obwohl er sehr schnell herausfindet, dass Giustinas Enkel Michele (Ludwig Trepte) mit der SchieSSerei zu tun haben muss, erhalt er von seinen Vorgesetzten den Befehl, sich bei seinen Ermittlungen zuruckzuhalten. Stattdessen soll er sich um einen banalen Fall von Graffiti-Parolen kummern, mit der eine Tierschutzgruppe fur ihre Ziele wirbt - wobei weder Laurenti noch seine Frau Laura (Barbara Rudnik) ahnen, dass auch ihr Sohn Marco (Sergej Moya) zu dieser Gruppe gehort, die von der exzentrischen Kunsthandlerin Graziella (Katharina Thalbach) unterstutzt wird. Unterdessen gewahrt ausgerechnet Laurentis alter Freund, der pensionierte Gerichtsmediziner Galvano (Rolf Hoppe), der vollig verangstigten Irina heimlich Unterschlupf. Galvano versucht schon lange, Giustinas dunkle Vergangenheit ans Licht zu bringen; die belastenden Akten kommen ihm wie gerufen. Als dann Branka Irina in ihre Gewalt bringt, uberschlagen sich die Ereignisse: Laurenti und Galvano versuchen, das Madchen gegen die Akten auszutauschen. Bei der Übergabe taucht vollig uberraschend der schwer bewaffnete Michele mit seinen Mannern auf - die Situation droht zu eskalieren.

programme.title: Morden im Norden
programme.desc: The master carpenter Herbert Heidemann, 55, is found dead in his living room. A small puncture between the shoulders indicates that the man has not died of a natural death. In forensic medicine, the assumption confirms that the victim died of an overdose of morphine. The suspicion of having murdered her husband with a syringe falls on Lola Heidemann, 30, a woman with a unusual past: she was a man -hanging slope and worked as a prostitute before studying medical studies. As a prospective doctor, she had easy access to the death of drugs. But why should she kill her husband? Finn and Lars find out that Herbert Heidemann has played a wrong game with Lola: the apparently demanding husband secretly torpedo his wife's career. Should she have come to his crazy? / Der Tischlermeister Herbert Heidemann, 55, wird tot in seinem Wohnzimmer aufgefunden. Eine kleine Einstichstelle zwischen den Schultern deutet darauf hin, dass der Mann keines naturlichen Todes gestorben ist. In der Rechtsmedizin bestatigt sich die Vermutung: Das Opfer starb an einer Überdosis Morphium. Der Verdacht, ihren Mann mit einer Spritze ermordet zu haben, fallt auf Lola Heidemann, 30, eine Frau mit ungewohnlicher Vergangenheit: Sie war fruher drogenabhangig und arbeitete als Prostituierte, bevor sie ein Medizinstudium begann. Als angehende Ärztin hatte sie leichten Zugriff auf die todlichen Drogen gehabt. Aber warum sollte sie ihren Mann umbringen? Finn und Lars finden heraus, dass Herbert Heidemann ein falsches Spiel mit Lola getrieben hat: Der scheinbar fordernde Ehemann hat die Karriere seiner Frau in Wahrheit heimlich torpediert. Sollte sie ihm auf die Schliche gekommen sein?

programme.title: Mord auf Shetland
programme.desc: The separated arm of a young man is found on the beach of Mainland. For Commissioner Jimmy Perez (Douglas Henshall), his assistant Tosh (Alison Odonnell) and Detective Constable Sandy Wilson (Steven Robertson) it is clear that it was hardly an accident on the high seas. When further, partially losing body parts are countered shortly afterwards, a murder case develops from this. Apparently someone wanted to make the victim's identity unrecognizable. The scrap handler Carla Hayes (Tracy Wiles) and her son Prentice (Owen Whitelaw) and Jamie (Lorn Macdonald) are suspected, and the investigators come across as a striking chemical. The Fischer Calum Dunwoody (Ryan Fletcher), which seems to be involved in smuggling and smuggling, also focused on in Perez. In the meantime, he finds out that the victim is Daniel Ugara (Ayanda Bhebe) from Nigeria. His mother Olivia Lennox (Rakie Ayola) living in London comes to Shetland to identify her son. Tosh soon finds out what the murdered one was looking for on the island: his sister Zezi (Titana Muthui), who was not traceless, who was apparently developed. Now the search for the young woman begins for Perez and his team. / Am Strand von Mainland wird der abgetrennte Arm eines jungen Mannes gefunden. Fur Kommissar Jimmy Perez (Douglas Henshall), seine Assistentin Tosh (Alison ODonnell) und Detective Constable Sandy Wilson (Steven Robertson) steht fest, dass es sich wohl kaum um einen Unfall auf hoher See gehandelt hat. Als kurz darauf weitere, teilweise aufgeloste Leichenteile angespult werden, entwickelt sich daraus ein Mordfall. Offenbar wollte jemand die Identitat des Opfers unkenntlich machen. Unter Verdacht geraten die Schrotthandlerin Carla Hayes (Tracy Wiles) und deren Sohne Prentice (Owen Whitelaw) und Jamie (Lorn Macdonald), auf deren Gelande die Ermittler auf Bestande einer auffalligen Chemikalie stoSSen. Auch der Fischer Calum Dunwoody (Ryan Fletcher), der in Schmuggel- und Schleusergeschafte verwickelt scheint, gerat in Perez Fokus. Inzwischen findet der heraus, dass es sich bei dem Opfer um den aus Nigeria stammenden Daniel Ugara (Ayanda Bhebe) handelt. Dessen in London lebende Mutter Olivia Lennox (Rakie Ayola) kommt nach Shetland, um ihren Sohn zu identifizieren. Schon bald findet Tosh heraus, was der Ermordete auf der Insel suchte: seine spurlos verschwundene Schwester Zezi (Titana Muthui), die offenbar entfuhrt wurde. Nun beginnt fur Perez und sein Team die Suche nach der jungen Frau.

programme.title: Cathe and me / Kathe und ich

Mit ihrem Vater Alexander (Arndt Schwering-Sohnrey), dem sie die Schuld fur die Trennung gibt, hat das fruhere "Papakind" gebrochen. Der erfahrene Therapeut weiSS, dass dies nur mit Unterstutzung ihrer Mutter geht. Um uberhaupt an sie heranzukommen, bringt er Kathe ins Spiel. Durch die Beschaftigung mit der Therapiehundin beginnt sich nicht nur die Mutter zu offnen, sondern auch Emma. Doch reicht die Zeit?Unterdessen bahnt sich fur Paul ein schmerzhafter Verlust an. Immer mehr entfernt sich seine Frau Erina (Nadja Bobyleva) von ihm. Zwar fasst die einstige Starballerina den Entschluss, ihr Leben in die Hand zu nehmen und gegen ihre Behinderung anzukampfen. Dass sie dem neuen Tierarzt Eric (Ulrich Friedrich Brandhoff) vertraut, macht Paul jedoch eifersuchtig. Naturlich weiSS er berufsbedingt, woher das kommt und wie man damit umgehen musste - doch Gefuhle sind eben nicht rational. Erina zuliebe ist er bereit, sein Leben komplett umzukrempeln.

programme.title: Cathe and me / Kathe und ich
programme.desc: Unfortunately, Roman (Nico Ramon Kleemann) cannot be carefree like other young people. As it turns out, his apathy has an organic cause. The 18-year-old suffers from a life-threatening liver disease. Roman does not want to accept an urgently needed organ donation that his half -sister Jasmina Thomas (Anna Hausburg) offers him despite his dramatic situation. Jasmin desperately turns to the psychologist Paul (Christoph Schechinger): He and his therapy dog ​​Kathe are supposed to convince novels to accept her offer - even if Jasmina puts her health in danger. Soon the experienced therapist realizes that the wrong motive is behind her offer: it is not sibling love, but the desire for the recognition of her father, the founded theater actor Fritz Thomas (Uwe Ochsenknecht). And as Paul finds out, it is a narcissist who also likes to steal responsibility. Paul did not want to evaluate that he does not offer himself as a donor, but it draws him attention to the problematic family relationships. Such a difficult decision as a partial liver donation, about which a medical commission must also be located, requires a stable basis. To create them, Paul relies on a holistic approach that also takes Fritz responsible. When Roman's situation deteriorates, there is little time for that. / Unbeschwert sein wie andere Jugendliche, das kann Roman (Nico Ramon Kleemann) leider nicht. Seine Apathie hat, wie sich herausstellt, eine organische Ursache. Der 18-jahrige leidet unter einer lebensgefahrlichen Lebererkrankung. Eine dringend benotigte Organspende, die ihm seine Halbschwester Jasmina Thomas (Anna Hausburg) anbietet, will Roman trotz seiner dramatischen Lage nicht annehmen. Verzweifelt wendet sich Jasmin an den Psychologen Paul (Christoph Schechinger): Er und seine Therapiehundin Kathe sollen Roman uberzeugen, ihr Angebot anzunehmen - auch wenn Jasmina ihre Gesundheit damit in Gefahr bringt. Schon bald merkt der erfahrene Therapeut, dass hinter ihrem Angebot jedoch das falsche Motiv steckt: Es ist namlich nicht Geschwisterliebe, sondern der Wunsch nach der Anerkennung ihres Vaters, des beruhmten Theaterschauspielers Fritz Thomas (Uwe Ochsenknecht). Und der ist, wie Paul herausfindet, ein Narzisst, der sich zudem gerne aus der Verantwortung stiehlt. Dass er sich nicht als Spender anbietet, mochte Paul zwar nicht bewerten, es macht ihn aber auf die problematischen Familienbeziehungen aufmerksam. Eine so schwere Entscheidung wie eine Teilleberspende, uber die zudem eine medizinische Kommission befinden muss, bedarf einer stabilen Basis. Um die zu schaffen, setzt Paul auf einen ganzheitlichen Ansatz, der auch Fritz in die Verantwortung nimmt. Als sich Romans Situation verschlechtert, bleibt dafur nur wenig Zeit.

programme.title: Schlosshotel Orth
programme.desc: The mountain farmer Sepp is found injured in his hat. Shortly afterwards, Fanny's girlfriend, the lawyer Maren Sammer, is pulled into a hollow during a walk by a stranger. The man Heit Branko, is Croatian and without a passport in Austria. He was at Sepp, which is why he is suspected of the robbery. Maren believes in his innocence and wants to help him. Eva competes in the sanatorium and finds out the truth about Felix and his wife, which Lilo does not want to succeed despite her penetrating interview practices ..... / Der Bergbauer Sepp wird bei seiner Hutte verletzt aufgefunden. Kurz danach wird Fannys Freundin, die Juristin Maren Sammer, wahrend eines Spazierganges von einem Unbekannten in eine Hohle gezogen. Der Mann heit Branko, ist Kroate und ohne PaSS in Österreich. Er war bei Sepp, weshalb er im Verdacht des Raubmordes steht. Maren glaubt an seine Unschuld und will ihm helfen. Eva tritt eine Urlaubsvertretung im Sanatorium an und findet die Wahrheit uber Felix und seine Frau heraus, was Lilo trotz ihrer penetranten Interviewpraktiken nicht gelingen will.....

programme.title: Erlebnis Österreich
programme.sub-title: The Bleitstatt Moor - from moor to the arable floor to the moor / Das Bleistatter Moor - Vom Moor zum Ackerboden zum Moor
programme.desc: The Bleitstatt Moor was once one of the greatest moor areas of Carnato with 600 hectares. In the course of hunger years in the interwar period, the moor was drained to use it for agriculture. As a result, trucks and dung agents with the flowering Tiebel were used unfiltered into the Ossiacher See. As a result, a massive algae plague developed in the lake. After multi -layered project coordinations, the Tiebel 75 hectares were flooded again from 2016 from 2016. As a filter, the removal basin reduces the entry of floating and nutrients into the Ossiacher See and thus once again raise the water quality, but today the large part of the dry-laid flat shares is still used for agriculture. The area around the flooded setting pools increasingly develops into a protected paradise for flora and fauna. And by the way, the species-rich nature, landscape and European protection area with the "Slow Trail" became a harmonious connection with the gentle tourism.The project Bleinstter Moor is the result of a wide range of cooperation between experts from the areas of water ecology, agriculture, nature conservation and tourism. / Das Bleistatter Moor war einst mit 600 Hektar eines der groSSten Moorgebiete Karntens. Im Zuge der Hungerjahre in der Zwischenkriegszeit wurde das Moor trockengelegt, um es landwirtschaftlich zu nutzen. Dadurch wurden Nahrstoffe und Dungemittel mit der durchstromenden Tiebel ungefiltert in den Ossiacher See gespult. In der Folge entwickelte sich im See eine massive Algenplage.So wurden nach vielschichtigen Projektkoordinationen ab 2016 im Mundungsbereich der Tiebel 75 Hektar wieder geflutet. Die entstandenen Absetzbecken verringern als Filter den Eintrag von Schweb- und Nahrstoffen in den Ossiacher See und heben somit wieder die Wasserqualitat.Heute wird der GroSSteil der trockengelegten Flachen im Rahmen des Naturschutzes nach wie vor landwirtschaftlich genutzt. Der Bereich um die gefluteten Absetzbecken entwickelt sich zunehmend zu einem geschutzten Paradies fur Flora und Fauna. Und nebenbei wurde das artenreiche Natur-, Landschafts- und Europaschutzgebiet mit dem "Slow Trail" zu einer harmonischen Verbindung mit dem sanften Tourismus.Das Projekt Bleistatter Moor ist das Ergebnis einer vieljahrigen Kooperation zwischen Fachleuten aus den Bereichen Gewasserokologie, Landwirtschaft, Naturschutz und Tourismus.

programme.title: Natur im Garten
programme.desc: Karl Ploberger prices a garden paradise in Styria, devotes himself to the climbing plants and Krauterhexe Uschi Zezelitsch in the world of the umbrella blooders. Ingrid and Alexander Moser have brought to life in Styrian St. Moser in the Murztal. The swimming pond is eye -catcher in the 3500m² garden, framed by a bluing rose hedge. Art is an important means for the two to be visually appealing to the garden. With climbing plants, the third dimension can be conquered in a confined space. Karl Ploberger has tips on the different types of climbers. Many may know him from a vacation on the Mediterranean - the sea fell. Krauterhexe Uschi Zezelitsch starts an oil that can be used for moisturizing the skin. Blickfang im 3500m² groSSen Garten ist der Schwimmteich, umrahmt von einer bluhenden Rosenhecke. Kunst ist fur die beiden ein wichtiges Mittel, um den Garten optisch ansprechend zu vollenden.Mit Kletterpflanzen kann auf engstem Raum die dritte Dimension erobert werden. Karl Ploberger hat Tipps zu den verschiedenen Arten von Kletterern.Viele kennen ihn vielleicht von einem Urlaub am Mittelmeer - den Meerfenchel. Krauterhexe Uschi Zezelitsch setzt daraus ein Öl an, das zur Feuchtigkeitspflege der Haut verwendet werden kann.Karl Ploberger beantwortet die Gartenfrage der Woche: Wann ist der beste Zeitpunkt fur die Kartoffelernte und wie lagere ich am besten ein?

programme.title: Österreich-Bild aus dem Landesstudio Burgenland
programme.sub-title: Diversity in the glass - Welschriesling rediscovered / Vielfalt im Glas - Welschriesling neu entdeckt
programme.desc: Almost missed as mass -produced goods for a long time, the Welschriesling has been rediscovered for several years. The range of the second most important white grape variety in Austria is astonishing. From the basic wine for sparkling wine over fresh, dry summer wines to Sussweinen from world call, also in the new style of orange or amphora wines, the Welschriesling shows what it can do. All of these facets can be discovered in Burgenland. For the first time, the so-called "Wosch Championship" has also been held here, a high-class tasting of this aspiring grape variety. / Lange Zeit als Massenware fast verpont, wird der Welschriesling seit einigen Jahren neu entdeckt. Die Bandbreite der zweitwichtigsten weiSSen Rebsorte Österreichs ist erstaunlich. Vom Grundwein fur Sekt uber frische, trockene Sommerweine bis hin zu SuSSweinen von Weltruf, auch in der neuen Stilistik von Orange- oder Amphorenweinen zeigt der Welschriesling, was er kann. All diese Facetten lassen sich im Burgenland entdecken. Erstmals ist hier auch die so genannte "Wosch-Meisterschaft" ausgetragen worden, eine hochklassige Verkostung dieser aufstrebenden Rebsorte.

programme.title: Sizilien - Mangelware Wasser
programme.desc: Dryness and lack of water are used to Sicily, but with climate change and mismanagement, the water shortage becomes increasingly extreme. Heat waves and thirst, licking water pipes and dilapidated memory, especially in the Suden, regularly drove that drinking water has to be rationed. The world journal in the agrigent region has looked around in Sicilia's sudwesten, which was most affected in the last year in record heat summer. Many residents get water with canisters from public water points because there is hardly any water from the lines at home. In hotels, the guest are asked to shower only for a maximum of three minutes to save water. A livestock breeder is that he has to bring some of his cattle to a butcher if the pastures continue to interfere. At the same time, water has become a lucrative: water suppliers sell the precious wet at high prices. Design: Giulia Ottaviano, Daniela Agostini / Auf Sizilien ist man Trockenheit und Wassermangel gewohnt, doch mit dem Klimawandel und Missmanagement wird die Wasserknappheit zusehends extremer. Hitzewellen und Durren, leckende Wasserleitungen und marode Speicher fuhren vor allem im Suden regelmaSSig dazu, dass Trinkwasser rationiert werden muss.Das WELTjournal hat sich in der Region Agrigent im Sudwesten Siziliens umgesehen, die im Rekord-Hitze-Sommer im Vorjahr am schlimmsten betroffen war. Viele Einwohner holen Wasser mit Kanistern von offentlichen Wasserstellen, weil aus den Leitungen zu Hause kaum Wasser kommt. In Hotels werden die Gaste gebeten, nur maximal drei Minuten zu duschen, um Wasser zu sparen. Ein Viehzuchter erzahlt, dass er einen Teil seiner Rinder zum Schlachter bringen muss, wenn die Weiden weiter ausdorren. Gleichzeitig ist Wasser zu einem lukrativen Geschaft geworden: Wasserlieferanten verkaufen das kostbare Nass zu hohen Preisen.Gestaltung: Giulia Ottaviano, Daniela Agostini

programme.title: Fokus Europa
programme.desc: Endlich frei!Die drei baltischen Lander Estland, Lettland und Litauen kappen ihre Stromleitungen nach Russland. Damit wird das Baltikum unabhangig von Energielieferungen aus Russland. Die europaische Union unterstutzt die teure Loslosung finanziell, vor allem weil Russland seine Stromlieferungen immer wieder auch ausnutzt, um politischen Druck aufzubauen. Stefan Gehrer war fur Fokus Europa in Litauen und hat die Demontage der Strommasten gefilmt.Dazu im Studio: Gunter Pauritsch, Energieagentur ÖsterreichRusslands stiller KriegDie europaischen Lander sind standig Opfer hybrider Angriffe, hinter denen mutmaSSlich meist Russland steckt. Dieser hybride Krieg findet bereits statt und die EU rustet sich mit GegenmaSSnahmen vor allem zum Schutz kritischer Infrastruktur. Fokus Europa hat das europaische Abwehrzentrum fur hybride Angriffe im finnischen Helsinki besucht.Schweiz startet in den WeltraumIn wenigen Jahren umkreisen zig-tausende Satelliten die Erde und Konzerne hoffen auf ein Milliardengeschaft im All. Deshalb beteiligt sich jetzt auch die Schweiz an der europaischen Weltraumagentur ESA und verspricht verlassliche Schweizer Qualitat fur die Raumfahrt. Marion Flatz-Maser berichtet aus der Schweiz.Moderation: Andreas Mayer-Bohusch

programme.title: Am Schauplatz
programme.sub-title: Bathing closing - the end of the swimming pool / Badeschluss - Das Ende der Schwimmbader
programme.desc: A report on the often desperate struggle of many communities to preserve no longer financed swimming pools all of Austria are faced with difficult decisions: rising energy costs, renovation backlogs and empty municipal health insurance companies drove to ensure that more and more free and indoor swimming pools have to be locked up. The swimming pool around the corner has long been a confidentiality. Now it becomes a luxury that many places can no longer afford. In the Kamp in the Kamp in the Waldviertel in Lower Easter, the outdoor pool has been closed for a year. "We complain to the costs. In the current situation, we do not have the money for a renovation of the swimming pool," said Mayor Alois Naber. A burger initiative has now set itself the goal of saving the swimming pool. A resident says: "I learned swimming here. My four children love the water. They cannot imagine Schonberg without a swimming pool." But the situation does not always have to be so hopeless. In Pinkafeld in Burgenland, the highly indebted community could no longer afford the indoor pool - then the bathroom was saved by the state of Burgenland, to the delight of the bathroom. A pensioner is convinced: "The swimming pools cannot be too expensive. Do you know how high the costs for the health system are when people get sick because they move too little?" Lifeguard Werner Ulreich agrees with him: "I think a swimming pool is like a children's playground. These things have to simply put the open hand for grouting." At the scene reporter Kim Kadlec, in summer in several federal countries and documented, such as indoor and free baters all over Austria disappeared and what consequences this has for all of us. And she shows how committed burgers try to save swimming pools and even operate them themselves, so that the children of the upcoming generation can still learn to swim at home. / Eine Reportage uber den oft verzweifelten Kampf vieler Gemeinden um den Erhalt von nicht mehr finanzierbaren SchwimmbadernIn ganz Österreich stehen Gemeinden vor schwierigen Entscheidungen: Steigende Energiekosten, Sanierungsstaus und leere Gemeindekassen fuhren dazu, dass immer mehr Frei- und Hallenbader zusperren mussen. Das Schwimmbad um die Ecke war lange eine Selbstverstandlichkeit. Jetzt wird es zum Luxus, den sich viele Orte nicht mehr leisten konnen.In Schonberg am Kamp im niederosterreichischen Waldviertel ist das Freibad seit einem Jahr geschlossen. "Wir scheitern klaglich an den Kosten. In der jetzigen Situation haben wir das Geld fur eine Sanierung des Schwimmbades nicht", sagt Burgermeister Alois Naber. Eine Burgerinitiative hat sich nun zum Ziel gesetzt das Schwimmbad doch noch zu retten. Eine Bewohnerin sagt: "Ich habe hier schwimmen gelernt. Meine vier Kinder lieben das Wasser. Sie konnen sich Schonberg ohne Schwimmbad gar nicht vorstellen."Doch die Situation muss nicht immer so ausweglos sein. In Pinkafeld im Burgenland konnte sich die hochverschuldete Gemeinde das Hallenbad nicht mehr leisten - dann wurde das Bad vom Land Burgenland gerettet, zur Freude der Badegaste. Ein Pensionist ist uberzeugt: "Die Schwimmbader konnen gar nicht zu teuer sein. Wissen Sie wie hoch die Kosten fur das Gesundheitssystem sind, wenn die Leute krank werden, weil sie sich zu wenig bewegen?" Bademeister Werner Ulreich stimmt ihm zu: "Ich finde ein Schwimmbad ist wie ein Kinderspielplatz. Diese Dinge muss die offentliche Hand einfach zur Verfugung stellen."Am Schauplatz-Reporterin Kim Kadlec war im Sommer in mehreren Bundeslandern unterwegs und dokumentiert, wie Hallen- und Freibader in ganz Österreich nach und nach verschwinden und welche Folgen das fur uns alle hat. Und sie zeigt, wie engagierte Burger und Burgerinnen versuchen, Schwimmbader zu retten und sie zur Not sogar selbst betreiben, damit die Kinder der kommenden Generation doch noch daheim schwimmen lernen konnen.

programme.title: Eco
programme.desc: Poor every day - what high inflation and low interest rates on the savings account do not really have it easy. Life in August has become 4.1 percent more expensive: Inflation, Austria is still significantly above the European average. But we only get small interest on our savings accounts. The result: we are constantly losing a lot of money. Private households have created 200 billion euros at banks. Unfortunately, it is half -fallen accounts. What does that mean specifically for the savers? And what can you do about this loss of purchasing power? Report: Bettina Fink, Johannes Schwitzer -Furnsinnöffis on the country - why is it so difficult to get by without your own car? In many places, the expansion is poor - almost 20 percent of all communities are outside the basic care. More than a million people hardly have the possibility to leave the car. Nevertheless, some regions have managed to improve their public connection. What did you do differently and how are the offers accepted? Report: Sophie -Kristin Hausberger, Miriam RESITION WITHOUT HYERKT - Why Germany is again on fossil energy. It is emission -free, easy to save and can be used for both the chemical industry and in the mobile line. In Saxony -Anhalt, the Bad Lauchstadt energy park tests hydrogen production and use. However, the already decided expansion of a hydrogen kernel network stalls by 2032. The German Federal Government is afraid of gulps in the event of weather -related fluctuations that can only partially close wind power and solar systems. Some industrial groups have already stopped their investments in H2 technology. The hydrogen turn was allowed to wait. Report: Andreas Pfeifer / Jeden Tag armer - was hohe Teuerung und niedrige Zinsen am Sparkonto anrichtenWir Österreicher habens echt nicht leicht. Das Leben im August ist um 4,1 Prozent teurer geworden: bei der Inflation liegt Österreich noch immer deutlich uber dem europaischen Durchschnitt. Doch auf unseren Sparkonten bekommen wir nur geringe Zinsen. Die Folge: wir verlieren laufend viel Geld. 200 Milliarden Euro haben Privathaushalte bei Banken zum Sparen angelegt. Leider liegt es aber zur Halfte auf taglich falligen Konten. Was bedeutet das konkret fur die Sparer? Und was kann man gegen diesen Verlust der Kaufkraft unternehmen? Bericht: Bettina Fink, Johannes Schwitzer-FurnsinnÖffis am Land - warum ist es so schwer, ohne eigenes Auto auszukommen?Der Umstieg vom Auto auf offentliche Verkehrsmittel hangt nicht nur vom guten Willen ab. Vielerorts ist der Ausbau mangelhaft - knapp 20 Prozent aller Gemeinden liegen auSSerhalb der Basisversorgung. Mehr als eine Million Menschen haben kaum die Moglichkeit, das Auto stehenzulassen. Trotzdem ist es manchen Regionen gelungen, ihre offentliche Anbindung zu verbessern. Was haben sie anders gemacht und wie werden die Angebote angenommen? Bericht: Sophie-Kristin Hausberger, Miriam RessiWende ohne Wasserstoff - warum Deutschland wieder auf fossile Energie setztEigentlich sollte gruner Wasserstoff fur die Energietransformation Deutschlands eine Hauptrolle spielen. Er ist emissionsfrei, leicht zu speichern und kann sowohl fur die chemische Industrie als auch im Mobilitatsbereich zur Anwendung kommen. In Sachsen-Anhalt testet der Energiepark Bad Lauchstadt die Wasserstofferzeugung und -nutzung. Doch der bereits beschlossene Ausbau eines Wasserstoff-Kernnetzes bis 2032 gerat ins Stocken. Die deutsche Bundesregierung furchtet Versorgungslucken bei witterungsbedingten Schwankungen, die Windkraft und Solaranlagen nur teilweise schlieSSen konnen. Einige Industriekonzerne haben ihre Investitionen in H2-Technologie bereits gestoppt. Die Wasserstoffwende durfte auf sich warten lassen. Bericht: Andreas Pfeifer

programme.title: WeltWeit
programme.desc: "I have been reporting from war and crisis areas for more than 35 years," says Karim El-Gawhary, ORF correspondent in the Arab world, "but I've never been locked out of a war". The fact that independent journalists are denied access to the Gaza Strip makes this war unique in a tragic way. The global Office is dependent on local cameramen and reporters-on men like the 28-year-old Abdel Khadr Hassouna, who has been working with Karim El-Gawhary for a year and a half and risks his life for this work every day. The war has become a war of the pictures and a propaganda battle, apart from destruction and death on the ground. Day for day he gives up on journalistic boundaries. As a so-called "embedded journalist", he was able to accompany the Israeli army to Gaza on a press tour. But after only two kilometers and an hour, the journey ended: "The impression from Gaza was very modest. We didn't see Palastinians a single one," warred leather at the end. For "worldwide" he also speaks to Gaza with Israeli journalists and residents of the border area and thus gets a deeper insight into the difficult handling of information and propaganda in Israel itself. The limits of report also reach ORF correspondent Nikolaus Wildner when he drives to his "worldwide" report in the West Bank occupied by Israel. The war in Gaza has been dominating the media for almost two years, which has reduced the reporting on the West Bank. But more than ever, the region is a powder barrel. "Once you have passed the checkpoint, you are exposed to different dangers as a reporter, it depends on whether you are in Ramallah in Arabic or in the areas of radical Israeli settlers," says Wildner. And the risk of media representatives in the West Bank always runs out of Israeli soldiers. Just a few days ago, a team of the "German Welle" was threatened with weapons when filming in Ramallah by the Israeli militar and specifically shot at with tranenas - despite the clear labeling as a press, "said the German broadcasting broadcaster. / "Seit mehr als 35 Jahren berichte ich aus Kriegs- und Krisengebieten", sagt Karim El-Gawhary, ORF-Korrespondent im arabischen Raum, "aber ich war noch nie aus einem Krieg ausgesperrt". Der Umstand, dass unabhangigen JournalistInnen der Zugang zum Gazastreifen verwehrt wird, macht diesen Krieg auf tragische Weise einzigartig. Die Weltoffentlichkeit ist auf lokale Kameramanner und ReporterInnen angewiesen - auf Manner wie den 28-jahrigen Abdel Khadr Hassouna, der seit eineinhalb Jahren mit Karim El-Gawhary zusammenarbeitet und fur diese Arbeit tagtaglich sein Leben riskiert. Der Krieg ist abseits von Zerstorung und Tod am Boden ein Krieg der Bilder und eine Propaganda-Schlacht geworden.Das erlebt auch ORF-Israel-Korrespondent David Kriegleder. Tag fur Tag stoSSt er an journalistische Grenzen. Als sogenannter "embedded journalist" konnte er die israelische Armee bei einer Presse-Tour nach Gaza begleiten. Doch nach nur zwei Kilometern und einer knappen Stunde endete die Reise: "Die Eindrucke aus Gaza waren sehr bescheiden. Palastinenser haben wir keinen einzigen zu Gesicht bekommen", resumiert Kriegleder am Ende. Fur "WeltWeit" spricht er auch mit israelischen Journalisten und Bewohnern des Grenzgebiets zu Gaza und bekommt so einen tieferen Einblick in den schwierigen Umgang mit Information und Propaganda in Israel selbst.An die Grenzen des Berichtens gelangt auch ORF-Korrespondent Nikolaus Wildner, als er fur seine "WeltWeit"-Reportage ins von Israel besetzte Westjordanland fahrt. Der Krieg in Gaza dominiert seit fast zwei Jahren die Medien, was die Berichterstattung uber das Westjordanland in den Hintergrund gedrangt hat. Doch mehr denn je ist die Region ein Pulverfass. "Wenn man den Checkpoint einmal passiert hat, ist man als Reporter unterschiedlichen Gefahren ausgesetzt, es hangt davon ab, ob man sich im arabischen Ramallah oder in den Gebieten der radikalen israelischen Siedler aufhalt", sagt Wildner. Und Gefahr fur Medienvertreter geht im Westjordanland immer ofter auch von israelischen Soldaten aus. WeltWeit
programme.desc: "I have been reporting from war and crisis areas for more than 35 years," says Karim El-Gawhary, ORF correspondent in the Arab world, "but I've never been locked out of a war". The fact that independent journalists are denied access to the Gaza Strip makes this war unique in a tragic way. The global Office is dependent on local cameramen and reporters-on men like the 28-year-old Abdel Khadr Hassouna, who has been working with Karim El-Gawhary for a year and a half and risks his life for this work every day. The war has become a war of the pictures and a propaganda battle, apart from destruction and death on the ground. Day for day he gives up on journalistic boundaries. As a so-called "embedded journalist", he was able to accompany the Israeli army to Gaza on a press tour. But after only two kilometers and an hour, the journey ended: "The impression from Gaza was very modest. We didn't see Palastinians a single one," warred leather at the end. For "worldwide" he also speaks to Gaza with Israeli journalists and residents of the border area and thus gets a deeper insight into the difficult handling of information and propaganda in Israel itself. The limits of report also reach ORF correspondent Nikolaus Wildner when he drives to his "worldwide" report in the West Bank occupied by Israel. The war in Gaza has been dominating the media for almost two years, which has reduced the reporting on the West Bank. But more than ever, the region is a powder barrel. "Once you have passed the checkpoint, you are exposed to different dangers as a reporter, it depends on whether you are in Ramallah in Arabic or in the areas of radical Israeli settlers," says Wildner. And the risk of media representatives in the West Bank always runs out of Israeli soldiers. Just a few days ago, a team of the "German Welle" was threatened with weapons when filming in Ramallah by the Israeli militar and specifically shot at with tranenas - despite the clear labeling as a press, "said the German broadcasting broadcaster. / "Seit mehr als 35 Jahren berichte ich aus Kriegs- und Krisengebieten", sagt Karim El-Gawhary, ORF-Korrespondent im arabischen Raum, "aber ich war noch nie aus einem Krieg ausgesperrt". Der Umstand, dass unabhangigen JournalistInnen der Zugang zum Gazastreifen verwehrt wird, macht diesen Krieg auf tragische Weise einzigartig. Die Weltoffentlichkeit ist auf lokale Kameramanner und ReporterInnen angewiesen - auf Manner wie den 28-jahrigen Abdel Khadr Hassouna, der seit eineinhalb Jahren mit Karim El-Gawhary zusammenarbeitet und fur diese Arbeit tagtaglich sein Leben riskiert. Der Krieg ist abseits von Zerstorung und Tod am Boden ein Krieg der Bilder und eine Propaganda-Schlacht geworden.Das erlebt auch ORF-Israel-Korrespondent David Kriegleder. Tag fur Tag stoSSt er an journalistische Grenzen. Als sogenannter "embedded journalist" konnte er die israelische Armee bei einer Presse-Tour nach Gaza begleiten. Doch nach nur zwei Kilometern und einer knappen Stunde endete die Reise: "Die Eindrucke aus Gaza waren sehr bescheiden. Palastinenser haben wir keinen einzigen zu Gesicht bekommen", resumiert Kriegleder am Ende. Fur "WeltWeit" spricht er auch mit israelischen Journalisten und Bewohnern des Grenzgebiets zu Gaza und bekommt so einen tieferen Einblick in den schwierigen Umgang mit Information und Propaganda in Israel selbst.An die Grenzen des Berichtens gelangt auch ORF-Korrespondent Nikolaus Wildner, als er fur seine "WeltWeit"-Reportage ins von Israel besetzte Westjordanland fahrt. Der Krieg in Gaza dominiert seit fast zwei Jahren die Medien, was die Berichterstattung uber das Westjordanland in den Hintergrund gedrangt hat. Doch mehr denn je ist die Region ein Pulverfass. "Wenn man den Checkpoint einmal passiert hat, ist man als Reporter unterschiedlichen Gefahren ausgesetzt, es hangt davon ab, ob man sich im arabischen Ramallah oder in den Gebieten der radikalen israelischen Siedler aufhalt", sagt Wildner.
