programme.title: Erlebnis Österreich
programme.sub-title: The Bleitstatt Moor - from moor to the arable floor to the moor / Das Bleistatter Moor - Vom Moor zum Ackerboden zum Moor
programme.desc: The Bleitstatt Moor was once one of the greatest moor areas of Carnato with 600 hectares. In the course of hunger years in the interwar period, the moor was drained to use it for agriculture. As a result, trucks and dung agents with the flowering Tiebel were used unfiltered into the Ossiacher See. As a result, a massive algae plague developed in the lake. After multi -layered project coordinations, the Tiebel 75 hectares were flooded again from 2016 from 2016. As a filter, the removal basin reduces the entry of floating and nutrients into the Ossiacher See and thus once again raise the water quality, but today the large part of the dry-laid flat shares is still used for agriculture. The area around the flooded setting pools increasingly develops into a protected paradise for flora and fauna. And by the way, the species-rich nature, landscape and European protection area with the "Slow Trail" became a harmonious connection with the gentle tourism.The project Bleinstter Moor is the result of a wide range of cooperation between experts from the areas of water ecology, agriculture, nature conservation and tourism. / Das Bleistatter Moor war einst mit 600 Hektar eines der groSSten Moorgebiete Karntens. Im Zuge der Hungerjahre in der Zwischenkriegszeit wurde das Moor trockengelegt, um es landwirtschaftlich zu nutzen. Dadurch wurden Nahrstoffe und Dungemittel mit der durchstromenden Tiebel ungefiltert in den Ossiacher See gespult. In der Folge entwickelte sich im See eine massive Algenplage.So wurden nach vielschichtigen Projektkoordinationen ab 2016 im Mundungsbereich der Tiebel 75 Hektar wieder geflutet. Die entstandenen Absetzbecken verringern als Filter den Eintrag von Schweb- und Nahrstoffen in den Ossiacher See und heben somit wieder die Wasserqualitat.Heute wird der GroSSteil der trockengelegten Flachen im Rahmen des Naturschutzes nach wie vor landwirtschaftlich genutzt. Der Bereich um die gefluteten Absetzbecken entwickelt sich zunehmend zu einem geschutzten Paradies fur Flora und Fauna. Und nebenbei wurde das artenreiche Natur-, Landschafts- und Europaschutzgebiet mit dem "Slow Trail" zu einer harmonischen Verbindung mit dem sanften Tourismus.Das Projekt Bleistatter Moor ist das Ergebnis einer vieljahrigen Kooperation zwischen Fachleuten aus den Bereichen Gewasserokologie, Landwirtschaft, Naturschutz und Tourismus.

programme.title: Sizilien - Mangelware Wasser
programme.desc: Dryness and lack of water are used to Sicily, but with climate change and mismanagement, the water shortage becomes increasingly extreme. Heat waves and thirst, licking water pipes and dilapidated memory, especially in the Suden, regularly drove that drinking water has to be rationed. The world journal in the agrigent region has looked around in Sicilia's sudwesten, which was most affected in the last year in record heat summer. Many residents get water with canisters from public water points because there is hardly any water from the lines at home. In hotels, the guest are asked to shower only for a maximum of three minutes to save water. A livestock breeder is that he has to bring some of his cattle to a butcher if the pastures continue to interfere. At the same time, water has become a lucrative: water suppliers sell the precious wet at high prices. Design: Giulia Ottaviano, Daniela Agostini / Auf Sizilien ist man Trockenheit und Wassermangel gewohnt, doch mit dem Klimawandel und Missmanagement wird die Wasserknappheit zusehends extremer. Hitzewellen und Durren, leckende Wasserleitungen und marode Speicher fuhren vor allem im Suden regelmaSSig dazu, dass Trinkwasser rationiert werden muss.Das WELTjournal hat sich in der Region Agrigent im Sudwesten Siziliens umgesehen, die im Rekord-Hitze-Sommer im Vorjahr am schlimmsten betroffen war. Viele Einwohner holen Wasser mit Kanistern von offentlichen Wasserstellen, weil aus den Leitungen zu Hause kaum Wasser kommt. In Hotels werden die Gaste gebeten, nur maximal drei Minuten zu duschen, um Wasser zu sparen. Ein Viehzuchter erzahlt, dass er einen Teil seiner Rinder zum Schlachter bringen muss, wenn die Weiden weiter ausdorren. programme.title: kreuz und quer
programme.desc: Taufers are considered a radical or left flight of the Reformation - and have their roots 500 years ago in Switzerland. They want to consistently follow Jesus and live according to the Bible. A resident says: "I learned swimming here. My four children love the water. They cannot imagine Schonberg without a swimming pool." But the situation does not always have to be so hopeless. In Pinkafeld in Burgenland, the highly indebted community could no longer afford the indoor pool - then the bathroom was saved by the state of Burgenland, to the delight of the bathroom. A pensioner is convinced: "The swimming pools cannot be too expensive. Do you know how high the costs for the health system are when people get sick because they move too little?" Lifeguard Werner Ulreich agrees with him: "I think a swimming pool is like a children's playground. These things have to simply put the open hand for grouting." At the scene reporter Kim Kadlec, in summer in several federal countries and documented, such as indoor and free baters all over Austria disappeared and what consequences this has for all of us. And she shows how committed burgers try to save swimming pools and even operate them themselves, so that the children of the upcoming generation can still learn to swim at home. / Eine Reportage uber den oft verzweifelten Kampf vieler Gemeinden um den Erhalt von nicht mehr finanzierbaren SchwimmbadernIn ganz Österreich stehen Gemeinden vor schwierigen Entscheidungen: Steigende Energiekosten, Sanierungsstaus und leere Gemeindekassen fuhren dazu, dass immer mehr Frei- und Hallenbader zusperren mussen. "Wir scheitern klaglich an den Kosten. In der jetzigen Situation haben wir das Geld fur eine Sanierung des Schwimmbades nicht", sagt Burgermeister Alois Naber. Eine Burgerinitiative hat sich nun zum Ziel gesetzt das Schwimmbad doch noch zu retten. Eine Bewohnerin sagt: "Ich habe hier schwimmen gelernt. Meine vier Kinder lieben das Wasser. Ein Pensionist ist uberzeugt: "Die Schwimmbader konnen gar nicht zu teuer sein. Wissen Sie wie hoch die Kosten fur das Gesundheitssystem sind, wenn die Leute krank werden, weil sie sich zu wenig bewegen?" Bademeister Werner Ulreich stimmt ihm zu: "Ich finde ein Schwimmbad ist wie ein Kinderspielplatz. Diese Dinge muss die offentliche Hand einfach zur Verfugung stellen."Am Schauplatz-Reporterin Kim Kadlec war im Sommer in mehreren Bundeslandern unterwegs und dokumentiert, wie Hallen- und Freibader in ganz Österreich nach und nach verschwinden und welche Folgen das fur uns alle hat. Und sie zeigt, wie engagierte Burger und Burgerinnen versuchen, Schwimmbader zu retten und sie zur Not sogar selbst betreiben, damit die Kinder der kommenden Generation doch noch daheim schwimmen lernen konnen.

programme.title: WeltWeit
programme.desc: "I have been reporting from war and crisis areas for more than 35 years," says Karim El-Gawhary, ORF correspondent in the Arab world, "but I've never been locked out of a war". The fact that independent journalists are denied access to the Gaza Strip makes this war unique in a tragic way. The global Office is dependent on local cameramen and reporters-on men like the 28-year-old Abdel Khadr Hassouna, who has been working with Karim El-Gawhary for a year and a half and risks his life for this work every day. The war has become a war of the pictures and a propaganda battle, apart from destruction and death on the ground. Day for day he gives up on journalistic boundaries. As a so-called "embedded journalist", he was able to accompany the Israeli army to Gaza on a press tour. But after only two kilometers and an hour, the journey ended: "The impression from Gaza was very modest. We didn't see Palastinians a single one," warred leather at the end. For "worldwide" he also speaks to Gaza with Israeli journalists and residents of the border area and thus gets a deeper insight into the difficult handling of information and propaganda in Israel itself. The limits of report also reach ORF correspondent Nikolaus Wildner when he drives to his "worldwide" report in the West Bank occupied by Israel. The war in Gaza has been dominating the media for almost two years, which has reduced the reporting on the West Bank. But more than ever, the region is a powder barrel. "Once you have passed the checkpoint, you are exposed to different dangers as a reporter, it depends on whether you are in Ramallah in Arabic or in the areas of radical Israeli settlers," says Wildner. And the risk of media representatives in the West Bank always runs out of Israeli soldiers. Just a few days ago, a team of the "German Welle" was threatened with weapons when filming in Ramallah by the Israeli militar and specifically shot at with tranenas - despite the clear labeling as a press, "said the German broadcasting broadcaster. / "Seit mehr als 35 Jahren berichte ich aus Kriegs- und Krisengebieten", sagt Karim El-Gawhary, ORF-Korrespondent im arabischen Raum, "aber ich war noch nie aus einem Krieg ausgesperrt". Der Umstand, dass unabhangigen JournalistInnen der Zugang zum Gazastreifen verwehrt wird, macht diesen Krieg auf tragische Weise einzigartig. Die Weltoffentlichkeit ist auf lokale Kameramanner und ReporterInnen angewiesen - auf Manner wie den 28-jahrigen Abdel Khadr Hassouna, der seit eineinhalb Jahren mit Karim El-Gawhary zusammenarbeitet und fur diese Arbeit tagtaglich sein Leben riskiert. Der Krieg ist abseits von Zerstorung und Tod am Boden ein Krieg der Bilder und eine Propaganda-Schlacht geworden.Das erlebt auch ORF-Israel-Korrespondent David Kriegleder. Tag fur Tag stoSSt er an journalistische Grenzen. Als sogenannter "embedded journalist" konnte er die israelische Armee bei einer Presse-Tour nach Gaza begleiten. Doch nach nur zwei Kilometern und einer knappen Stunde endete die Reise: "Die Eindrucke aus Gaza waren sehr bescheiden. Palastinenser haben wir keinen einzigen zu Gesicht bekommen", resumiert Kriegleder am Ende. Fur "WeltWeit" spricht er auch mit israelischen Journalisten und Bewohnern des Grenzgebiets zu Gaza und bekommt so einen tieferen Einblick in den schwierigen Umgang mit Information und Propaganda in Israel selbst.An die Grenzen des Berichtens gelangt auch ORF-Korrespondent Nikolaus Wildner, als er fur seine "WeltWeit"-Reportage ins von Israel besetzte Westjordanland fahrt. Der Krieg in Gaza dominiert seit fast zwei Jahren die Medien, was die Berichterstattung uber das Westjordanland in den Hintergrund gedrangt hat. Doch mehr denn je ist die Region ein Pulverfass. "Wenn man den Checkpoint einmal passiert hat, ist man als Reporter unterschiedlichen Gefahren ausgesetzt, es hangt davon ab, ob man sich im arabischen Ramallah oder in den Gebieten der radikalen israelischen Siedler aufhalt", sagt Wildner. Und Gefahr fur Medienvertreter geht im Westjordanland immer ofter auch von israelischen Soldaten aus. Erst vor wenigen Tagen wurde ein Team der "Deutschen Welle" bei Dreharbeiten in Ramallah vom israelischen Militar mit Waffen bedroht und gezielt mit Tranengas beschossen - trotz klarer Kennzeichnung als Presse", teilte der deutsche Auslandssender mit.

programme.title: 3 at the round table / 3 Am Runden Tisch
Amazons in the Middle Kingdom - China's Legendar Warriors / Amazonen im Reich der Mitte - Chinas legendare Kriegerinnen
programme.desc: Konigin Hao is one of the most successful bronze agents. At the age of 17 she married to the courtyard of the rising Shang dynasty in today's central China and becomes the supreme general of the empire and closest consultant for her husband, the king Wu Ding. At the age of 35, she died under councilor -like circumstances - as a result, rival she was poisoned at the Konigshof. Her grave from the 13th century BC is one of the richest graves of the Bronze Age. There is information about Shang's craftsmanship, through which they were militarically transferred to their enemies. The oracles, which were written on turtle armor and animal bones, show how important the Shang prophecy in military campaigns were. / Konigin Hao ist eine der erfolgreichsten Heerfuhrerinnen der Bronzezeit. Mit 17 Jahren heiratet sie an den Hof der aufsteigenden Shang-Dynastie im heutigen Zentralchina und wird oberste Generalin des Reiches und engste Beraterin ihres Mannes, des Konigs Wu Ding. Mit 35 Jahren stirbt sie unter ratselhaften Umstanden - moglicherweise wurde sie von Rivalen am Konigshof vergiftet. Ihr Grab aus dem 13. Jahrhundert vor Christus ist eine der reichsten Grabstatten der Bronzezeit. Es gibt Auskunft uber die Handwerkskunst der Shang, durch die sie ihren Feinden militarisch uberlegen waren. Die Orakel, die auf Schildkrotenpanzer und Tierknochen geschrieben wurden, zeigen, wie wichtig den Shang Weissagungen bei militarischen Feldzugen waren.Die Universum History- Dokumentation zeichnet das kriegerische Leben und Sterben von Konigin Hao in spektakularen Reenactments nach.

programme.title: Oktoberfest 1900
programme.desc: Under the influence of a spiritual encounter with his deceased wife and her warning, Prank gives up his revenge tarpaulin in comparison to the Hofoflingers and gives them a different Oktoberfest place. Now Glogauer has to find a new buyer for his explosive film material. Colina is now being caught up by her past and tries to defend herself. A scandal let the Oktoberfest tent shake and leads to a trot up. / Unter dem Einfluss einer spirituellen Begegnung mit seiner verstorbenen Frau und deren Ermahnungen, gibt Prank seine Racheplane gegenuber den Hoflingers auf und lasst ihnen einen anderen Wiesn-Platz zukommen. Nun muss Glogauer einen neuen Kaufer fur sein brisantes Filmmaterial finden. Colina wird inzwischen von ihrer Vergangenheit eingeholt und versucht sich zu wehren. Ein Eklat lasst das Oktoberfestzelt erbeben und fuhrt zu einer Tragodie.

programme.title: Oktoberfest 1900
programme.desc: The beer cartel has ensured that in the next year only the seven greatest Muncher breweries will receive a license for a beer castle at the Oktoberfest. To make people laugh and to let her forget her worries was Alfred Bohm's artistic credo. Otto Schenk names his good observation and his natural game as the secret of his success. The figures shown by Alfred Bohm are people like you and me. In interaction with Otto Schenk or with his namesake Maxi Bohm, he gave the Austrians a great moment of comodic art. The documentary traces life stations and reviews unforgettable theater and TV moments. / Ob auf dem Theater oder im Fernsehen, ob als Leihopa, Mustergatte oder Ober Alfred im "Seniorenclub". Alfred Bohm erfreute sich jahrzehntelang ungebrochen der Liebe seines Publikums.Die Menschen zum Lachen zu bringen und sie ihre Sorgen vergessen zu lassen war das kunstlerische Credo von Alfred Bohm. Otto Schenk nennt seine gute Beobachtungsgabe und sein naturliches Spiel als Geheimnis seines Erfolgs. Die von Alfred Bohm dargestellten Figuren sind Menschen wie Du und Ich. programme.title: Heinz Marecek - 100 years of Viennese cabaret / Heinz Marecek - 100 Jahre Wiener Kabarett
programme.desc: The Viennese cabaret has been a hundred years old - an institution that has become immortal through artists such as Karl Farkas, Fritz Grunbaum, Armin Berg or Peter Hammerschlag. The humorist and actor Heinz Marecek, whose artistic vita has always run in the gravitational field of this time, on the occasion of this anniversary to a reading of exemplary entertainment texts. The focus is on the legendary Budapest Orpheum, which first appeared in the Vienna "Hotel zum Schwarzen Adler" in 1889. Soon they were just "the Budapesters". On this jargon stage, the ancient Talmudic humor mixed with the esprit of the Hungarian bourgeoisie and the language of the urban Viennese Judaism to a unique mix, which was not least the genre of the double conference. An overtake entertaining evening with texts that you can't get enough of. / Das Wiener Kabarett ist hundert Jahre alt geworden - eine Institution, die durch Kunstler wie Karl Farkas, Fritz Grunbaum, Armin Berg oder Peter Hammerschlag unsterblich geworden ist. Der Humorist und Schauspieler Heinz Marecek, dessen kunstlerische Vita immer im Gravitationsfeld dieser Zeit verlaufen ist, ladt anlasslich dieses Jubilaums zu einer Lesung exemplarischer Unterhaltungstexte. Im Zentrum steht das legendare Budapester Orpheum, das erstmals 1889 im Wiener "Hotel zum schwarzen Adler" aufgetreten ist. Bald waren sie einfach nur mehr "die Budapester". Auf dieser Jargonbuhne vermischte sich der uralte talmudische Humor mit dem Esprit der ungarischen Bourgeoisie und der Sprache des urbanen Wiener Judentums zu einer einzigartigen Mischung, die nicht zuletzt das Genre der Doppelconference erfand. Ein uberaus unterhaltsamer Abend mit Texten, von denen man nicht genug bekommen kann.

programme.title: Heinz Marecek - 100 years of Viennese cabaret / Heinz Marecek - 100 Jahre Wiener Kabarett
programme.desc: Audience favorite Heinz Marecek continues his journey through a hundred years of Viennese cabaret, who has always been fascinated by this time and her protagonists. "I had the privilege with my friend Karlheinz Hackl as a partner to play the blodes for years, and there are not many evenings on my gray that had given me as untrusted pleasure as the evenings with him." This evening, however, it's about the solo artists. The title of Marecek's program is a poem by Fritz Grunbaum "My colleague, the monkey", with which Karl Farkas opened the domestic post -war cabaret immediately after the war in the Simpl, as reverence before his long -term mentor and partner. / Publikumsliebling Heinz Marecek setzt seine Reise durch hundert Jahre Wiener Kabarett fort, der selbst immer fasziniert von dieser Zeit und ihren Protagonisten gewesen ist. "Ich hatte das Privileg, mit meinem Freund Karlheinz Hackl als Partner, jahrelang den Bloden spielen zu durfen, und es gibt nicht viele Abende auf der Buhne, die mir so ungetrubtes Vergnugen bereitet hatten, wie die Abende mit ihm." An diesem Abend geht es jedoch um die Solokunstler. Der Titel von Mareceks Programm ist ein Gedicht von Fritz Grunbaum "Mein Kollege, der Affe", mit dem Karl Farkas unmittelbar nach dem Krieg im Simpl das heimische Nachkriegskabarett eroffnete, als Reverenz vor seinem langjahrigen Mentor und Partner.

It is about the affairs of Franz Ferdinand's young brother, the "beautiful Otto", in the Palais Augarten. R: Susanne Pleisnitzer / Liebe und Ehe, das hatte lange Zeit wenig miteinander zu tun. In Teil zwei dieser neuen Erbe Österreich Serie setzt Karl Hohenlohe seine Tour durch Wiens erotische Statten fort. In der Favorita - dem heutigen Theresianum - lebte Karl VI., der hier nicht nur in die Geheimnisse des ehelichen Vollzugs eingeweiht wurde, sondern auch seiner Liebe zu Mannern entdeckte. programme.title: Weinstadt Wien
programme.desc: Vienna and the wine - many think that these two names do not see themselves as chance, there is a particularly intimate relationship between the city and the drink. For a long time, Vienna was not only a consumer of the vine juice, but also one of the greatest producers. Stadtische vineyards such as on the Cobenzl are only the last remnants of the former onological great of the imperial city. Since water, which was mostly contaminated, when a drink left, adults only drank wine or beer against thirst. Consumption was correspondingly high, and so the logistics were designed: huge wine cellars ran through the belly of Vienna. To date, the world -size wine barrel can be admired in the city center. Director Stefan Gavac and the authors Andreas and Carola Augustin took a closer look at the gigantic wine dimension of historical Vienna in this ORF III Erbe Austria. / Wien und der Wein - viele meinen ja, dass sich diese beiden Namen nicht zufallig so ahnlich sehen, besteht zwischen der Stadt und dem Getrank doch eine besonders innige Beziehung. Dabei war Wien uber lange Zeit nicht nur ein Konsument des Rebensaftes, sondern auch einer der groSSten Produzenten. Stadtische Weinguter wie etwa am Cobenzl sind nur letzte Reste der einstigen onologischen GroSSe der Kaiserstadt. Da Wasser, das meistens verseucht war, als Getrank ausschied, tranken Erwachsene gegen den Durst nur Wein oder Bier. Entsprechend hoch war der Konsum, und so war auch die Logistik ausgelegt: Riesige Weinkeller zogen sich durch den Bauch von Wien. Bis heute ist in der Innenstadt das weltgroSSte Weinfass zu bestaunen. Regisseur Stefan Gavac und die Autoren Andreas und Carola Augustin haben sich die gigantische Wein-Dimension des historischen Wien in dieser ORF III Erbe Österreich Neuproduktion genauer angesehen.

Die einen kamen dadurch zu Geld und stieSSen in die burgerlichen Salons vor, die anderen konnten sich vor einer sonst reservierten Wiener Gesellschaft als Mazene und Schongeister profilieren. Die Akzeptanz judischer GroSSburger und Industrieller blieb allerdings uber weite Strecken ein Wunschtraum. Selbst in ihrer Hochblute wurden viele von ihnen als "Parvenus" ausgegrenzt. Erst recht die politische Agitation des antisemitischen Burgermeisters Karl Lueger und das Aufkommen der Nazis lieSSen diese Erzahlung im fruhen zwanzigsten Jahrhundert abreiSSen.

programme.title: Land der Berge

Between traditional shepherds, impressive nature and the return of the great prey, the film is raised by courage, dedication and the search for new ways for a life with the wolf. / Mitten in der rauen Schonheit der Berge trotzen einige wenige Idealistinnen Wind, Wetter - und dem Wolf. Diese neue "Land der Berge"-Dokumentation begleitet moderne Hirtinnen wie Anna, die jeden Sommer mit ihren Schafen in die Einsamkeit der Berge zieht, sowie Jager, Biobauern und Naturschutzer, die alle auf ihre Weise versuchen, ein uraltes Gleichgewicht wiederherzustellen: jenes zwischen Mensch, Tier und Wildnis. programme.title: Das Villgratental in Osttirol
programme.desc: "Come to us, we have nothing!" - A mountain fan in the Villgratental once said to a travel journalist out of fun - and now this saying has become a fluggelical word. In the quiet side arm of the Puster Valley there are no monstrous bed castles, shopping centers, amusement parks and not even lifts - only pure nature. Surrounded by meadows, pastures, forest and mountains, you can quarter yourself in small inns, holiday apartments and alpine huts and let your mind wander. The Villgrat Valley in East Tyrol is a paradise for vacationers who want to avoid mass and event tourism. But the idyll is threatened. The voices, which overflowed for a stronger tourist development, are getting louder: If you don't invest your vigorously soon, you say, the remote valley will lose the connection completely. (Doku 2020) / "Kommen Sie zu uns, wir haben nichts!" - hat ein Bergfuhrer im Villgratental einmal aus SpaSS zu einem Reisejournalisten gesagt - und mittlerweile ist dieser Spruch zum geflugelten Wort geworden. In dem stillen Seitenarm des Pustertals gibt es keine monstrosen Bettenburgen, Einkaufszentren, Freizeitparks und nicht einmal Lifte - nur Natur pur. Umgeben von Wiesen, Weiden, Waldern und Bergen kann man sich in kleinen Gasthofen, Ferienwohnungen und Almhutten einquartieren und ungestort die Seele baumeln lassen. Das Villgratental in Osttirol ist ein Paradies fur Urlauber, die dem Massen- und Event-Tourismus entgehen wollen. Doch die Idylle ist bedroht. Die Stimmen, die fur eine starkere touristische ErschlieSSung pladieren, werden immer lauter: wenn man nicht bald kraftig investiere, sagen sie, werde das abgelegene Tal den Anschluss vollig verlieren. (Doku 2020)

programme.title: Auf Hutten und Almen im Rosengarten
programme.desc: There is a deep kar with a small lake between the Vajoletturmen, the Laurinswand and the Rosengarten. The hollow is called the "Gartl". Here was the entrance to the palace of the dwarf king Laurin, and all around the splendid roses. Today the gartl hoot is standing here. Valeria Pallotta bought it and now, she says, she is the king up here. If sometimes a mountaineer is waiting in vain for his customer on the gartlhutte, then Valeria grabs him and they climb two or three ropes together. The delagoturm has thirty -like rope, and we climbed this with Valeria and the mountain fabio Giongo. From the Delagoturm we see in all the wonderful places that we visited for the film. We see the hates on the tschaft, where the food tastes so good, also because everything that is on the menu comes from our own gemarten, from the forest and our own stable. Grandma Josefine is 86 years old and is still behind the stove. We guess from here the grass haute, which is operated by three funny dropouts and two Indian cooking. Klaus and Barbara are the shepherd and the dairy. Klaus hints the cattle in the green spots between the vertical rockwands. He was a truck driver earlier and saw a lot of the world, "but I have never been to a place where it was like here," he says. / Zwischen den Vajoletturmen, der Laurinswand und dem Rosengarten liegt ein tiefes Kar mit einem kleinen See. Man nennt die Mulde das "Gartl". Hier befand sich einmal der Eingang zu dem Palast des Zwergenkonigs Laurin, und ringsherum haben die prachtigsten Rosen gebluht. Heute steht hier die Gartlhutte. Valeria Pallotta hat sie vor funf Jahren gekauft und jetzt, so sagt sie, ist sie die Konigin hier oben. Wenn manchmal auf der Gartlhutte ein Bergfuhrer vergeblich auf seinen Kunden wartet, dann schnappt Valeria ihn sich, und sie klettern zusammen zwei oder drei Seillangen.Drei Seillangen hat der Delagoturm, und diesen haben wir mit Valeria und dem Bergfuhrer Fabio Giongo erklommen. Vom Delagoturm aus sehen wir auf all die herrlichen Orte, die wir fur den Film besucht haben.Wir sehen die Hutte am Tschafon, wo das Essen so gut schmeckt, auch weil alles, was auf der Karte steht, aus dem eigenen Gemusegarten, aus dem Wald und dem eigenen Stall kommt. Oma Josefine ist 86 Jahre alt und steht immer noch hinter dem Herd.Wir erahnen von hier oben die Grasleitenhutte, die von drei lustigen Aussteigern und zwei indischen Kochen betrieben wird.Am FuSSe der Nordflanke des Delagoturms, 600 Meter senkrecht unter dem Gipfel, liegt die Haniker Schweige. Klaus und Barbara sind hier der Hirte und die Sennerin. Klaus hutet das Vieh in den grunen Flecken zwischen den senkrechten Felswanden. Fruher war er Lastwagenfahrer und hat einiges von der Welt gesehen, "aber noch nie war ich an einem Ort, wo es so schon war wie hier", sagt er.

programme.title: The Piefke saga - the history of the cult series / Die Piefke-Saga - Die Geschichte der Kultreihe
programme.desc: The ORF III production deals with the legendary film series "Die Piefke-Saga". Germans and Austrians, the difficult relationship between tourists from Berlin and local Tyroleans, was put on the grain in the 1990s by Felix Mitterer with a sharp tongue. In the fictional town of Lahnenberg in Tirol, the history of hate love between the Tyrolean hotelier family Wechselberger and the Krimbacher farmers from the Rotterhof played on one side and the Berlin entrepreneur family Sattmann on the other. With biting sarcasm, Mitterer designs a deteriorated moral image between pordering and exploitation of domestic tourism. Violent discussions after the broadcast were guaranteed. The fourth and last part was so controversial that it was not broadcast for a long time and was only shown again in ORF from 2005. In addition to numerous original scenes and backgrounds to the films and their reception, director with Felix Mitterer and other central protagonists of the films can also be seen. / Die ORF-III-Produktion beschaftigt sich mit der legendaren Filmreihe "Die Piefke-Saga". Deutsche und Österreicher, das schwierige Verhaltnis zwischen Touristen aus Berlin und einheimischen Tirolern wurde in den 1990ern von Felix Mitterer mit scharfer Zunge aufs Korn genommen. Im fiktiven Ort Lahnenberg in Tirol spielte die Geschichte der Hassliebe zwischen der Tiroler Hoteliersfamilie Wechselberger und der Bauernfamilie Krimbacher vom Rotterhof auf der einen Seite und der Berliner Unternehmerfamilie Sattmann auf der anderen. Mit beiSSendem Sarkasmus entwirft Mitterer ein verkommenes Sittenbild zwischen Anbiederung und Ausbeutung des heimischen Tourismus. Heftige Diskussionen nach der Ausstrahlung waren garantiert. Der vierte und letzte Teil war so kontroversiell, dass er lange Zeit nicht ausgestrahlt wurde und erst ab 2005 wieder im ORF gezeigt wurde. programme.title: Walser autumn - the steepest festival in the mountains / Walserherbst - Das steilste Festival in den Bergen
programme.desc: Every two years, visitors from all over the world into the big Walsertal in Vorarlberg to a festival, which is only in its kind. This is not only due to the steep hanging of the valley, where hikes end in concert or performance. The active participation of people from the valley is also steeply increasing. Together with the visitors, they explore the charm, the tradition, the force of the Walserische. They like to look over the box, keep their eyes, ears and heart open to new things. The motto is "foresight". The program includes exhibitions, concerts, theaters, readings, but also specially created formats such as the music workshop "Radix" or the sound carpet, which the artist group "Aoand" weighs together with visitors from the sound of the valley. / Alle zwei Jahre stromen Besucher aus der ganzen Welt ins GroSSe Walsertal in Vorarlberg zu einem Festival, das einzig ist in seiner Art. programme.title: Normal
programme.desc: The program "Normal" is primarily about people with a handicap and their everyday life. Using interviews or magazine contributions, an insight is preserved. For example, the inclusion at work as well as the trip of a globetrotter in a wheelchair was, among other things. / In der Sendung "Normal" geht es vor allem um Menschen mit Handicap und ihren Alltag. Anhand von Interviews oder Magazin-Beitragen wird ein Einblick gewahrt. So war zum Beispiel unter anderem die Inklusion am Arbeitsplatz Thema genauso wie die Reise eines Globetrotters im Rollstuhl.

programme.title: Highway Patrol
programme.desc: Die Doku-Serie "Highway Patrol" begleitet australische Verkehrspolizisten, die unter anderem uber Geschwindigkeitsbeschrankungen wachen und Alkoholsunder Down Under uberfuhren. Bei Blech- und Personenschaden sind Absicherung der Unfallstellen im Bundesstaat Victoria und die akribische Ermittlung der Ursachen lebenswichtig.

programme.title: The PS professionals - more power from the pot / Die PS-Profis - Mehr Power aus dem Pott
programme.desc: Jean Pierre and Sidney put you in a good mood at the Autocheck: Even in the new season of "The PS Professionals-More Power from the Pott" The Ruhrpott duo in every show will find the order of Sport1 viewers to find a suitable used one. They give tips and tricks, call the specific weaknesses of individual models, reveal the tricks of the seller and show how to buy good used cars for little money. / Jean Pierre und Sidney machen gute Laune beim Autocheck: Auch in der neuen Staffel von "Die PS PROFIS - mehr Power aus dem Pott" erhalt das Ruhrpott-Duo in jeder Sendung den Auftrag von SPORT1-Zuschauern, einen passenden Gebrauchten zu finden. Dabei geben sie Tipps und Tricks, nennen die spezifischen Schwachstellen einzelner Modelle, verraten die Kniffe der Verkaufer und zeigen, wie man fur wenig Geld gute gebrauchte Autos kaufen kann.

Als er gewahlt wird, ahnt kaum jemand, wie sehr der Krieg seine Amtszeit pragen wird.Die Folgen einer Meldung aus China lassen sich Ende 2019 ebenfalls kaum erahnen. In der Stadt Wuhan wird ein mysterioser Virus entdeckt, der dem SARS-Erreger ahnlich sein soll. Die Coronakrise ist im Anmarsch.In der vierteiligen ZDFinfo-Dokumentation blicken Prominente, Zeitzeugen und Journalisten auf die 2010er-Jahre zuruck und berichten uber ihre Erlebnisse und Einschatzungen. Mit dabei sind unter anderen Oliver Welke, Felix von der Laden, Kerstin Ott, Aminata Belli, El Hotzo, Lena Klenke, Tarik Tesfu und Jana Pareigis.Die 2010er - ein Jahrzehnt der Illusionen und Versaumnisse, deren Folgen erst in den Jahren danach sichtbar werden. Aber vieles kommt auch in Bewegung: Ganz Deutschland wird digital, Frauen brechen ihr Schweigen, und viele machen sich stark - fur Klimaschutz, Vielfalt und Demokratie.

Jahrhundert denkmalpflegerisch erhalten werden.Das legendare 24-Stunden Rennen uber die Nordschleife des Nurburgrings ist ein Megaevent. Ab sofort herrscht Eiszeit zwischen den alten Freunden - und dann verschwindet ein weiteres Madchen."Das letzte Opfer" ist nach "Morder ohne Erinnerung" (2003) und "Ungesuhnt" (2009) der dritte Kino-Auftritt des Ermittlerduos Vincke/Verstuyft alias Koen De Bouw/Werner De Smedt in der Verfilmung eines Krimis von Jef Geeraerts. In Deutschland am bekanntesten allerdings sind seine Rollen in den drei Verfilmungen der Bucher seines flamischen Landsmanns Jef Geeraerts, des 2015 verstorbenen preisgekronten und sehr produktiven Autors, der zwischen 1962 und 2002 ganze 52 Romane veroffentlicht hat. programme.title: A more-what-perfect goodbye / Um Adeus Mais-Que-Perfeito
programme.desc: The theater piece from the novel of the Austrian writer Peter Handke, centered on the memory and mourning process of an individual in the face of his mother's death. The protagonist, through a narrative style that mixes memory and reflex, seeks to understand what the death of the mother represents and how it affects his life and his understanding of the world. Written in the winter of 1972, during the process of mourning the death of the mother, the novel "a good goodbye" tells us the spiral of pain and suffering that led to the Austrian writer's mother, a nobel premium of literature, to suicide at the age of 51. Handke's mother's story and a report of the life of a Central European woman in a difficult time, marked by World War II. It is the story of a woman born in the wreckage of the imperies that ruined in the First World War on the territory that now belongs to Austria, but also with Slovenian roots and in a country later annexed by Nazi Germany, from which the writer's father is originally. Written by his son, reported by a male voice, the play has a feminist look at the suffering and condition of women. The writer's mother originates in a rural world, breakfast, conservative and Catholic, where women were seen as impertinent and light if they dare to have a voice. The text and way Peter Handke found to exorcise his suffering and find a comfort with the premature death of the mother, but also and an account of human life and existence. / Peça de teatro a partir do romance do escritor austríaco Peter Handke, centrada na memoria e no processo de luto de um indivíduo diante da morte da sua mae. O protagonista, atraves de um estilo narrativo que mistura memoria e reflexao, busca entender o que a morte da mae representa e como afeta a sua vida e a sua compreensao do mundo. Escrito no Inverno de 1972, durante o processo de luto pela morte da mae, o romance "Um Adeus Mais-Que-Perfeito" conta-nos a espiral de dor e sofrimento que levou a mae do escritor austríaco, Premio Nobel da Literatura, ao suicídio aos 51 anos de idade. A historia da mae de Handke e um relato da vida de uma mulher da Europa Central num período difícil, marcado pela Segunda Guerra Mundial. É a historia de uma mulher nascida nos destroços dos imperios que ruíram na primeira guerra mundial no territorio que agora pertence à Áustria, mas tambem com raízes eslovenas e num país mais tarde anexado pela Alemanha nazi, de onde e originário o pai do escritor. Escrita pelo filho, relatada por uma voz masculina, a peça tem um olhar feminista sobre o sofrimento e a condiçao das mulheres. A mae do escritor tem origem num mundo rural, pequeno-burgues, conservador e catolico, onde as mulheres eram vistas como impertinentes e levianas caso ousassem ter voz. O texto e a forma que Peter Handke encontrou para exorcizar o seu sofrimento e encontrar um consolo com a morte prematura da mae, mas tambem e um relato sobre a vida e a existencia humana.

programme.title: Liverpool vs Everton - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 5
programme.desc: Liverpool have lost just one of their last 28 home games against Everton in all competitions, winning each of their last four in a row since a 0-2 defeat in February 2021. Only from February 1933 to January 1937 have the Reds ever won five straight home matches against the Toffees. Everton have won just two of their last 29 Premier League Merseyside derbies against Liverpool and have failed to score in five of their last seven.

programme.title: Real Madrid vs Espanyol - Spanish LaLiga 2025/26 - Week 5
programme.desc: Real Madrid have won 24 and drawn three of their last 27 home games against Espanyol in LaLiga, winning the last 10, the best unbeaten run and winning streak at home against Espanyol in their history in the competition. Espanyol have lost 108 of their 178 matches against Real Madrid in LaLiga, the highest number of defeats suffered by any team against another in the history of the competition.

programme.title: Manchester United vs Chelsea - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 5
programme.desc: Manchester United are unbeaten in their last 12 Premier League home games against Chelsea since a 0-1 defeat in May 2013. Indeed, Chelsea’s win rate of 18% at Old Trafford in the Premier League is their lowest away to any side they have visited 10+ times in the competition. After their 1-0 win in May, Chelsea are looking for successive league victories over Manchester United for the first time since winning three in a row from November 2009 to March 2011 under Carlo Ancelotti. The Blues’ two wins in their last three league games versus the Red Devils are as many as their previous 17 beforehand.

programme.title: Argentina vs Brazil - Final - 2025 FIBA AmeriCup
programme.desc: South America’s classic rivalry decides the AmeriCup. Argentina are the reigning champions with three titles (2001, 2011, 2022), while Brazil are four-time winners (1984, 1988, 2005, 2009). Argentina lead the senior head-to-head 25–17. Their last AmeriCup meeting was the 2022 final in Recife, which Argentina won 75–73; at the 2019 World Cup second round, Argentina won 87–73. Current FIBA Men’s World Ranking: Argentina No. 8, Brazil No. 12. Expect a tactical game where turnover margin, second-chance points, and late free throws decide it.

programme.title: Fulham vs Brentford - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 5

programme.title: Martial Sport - MMA: Salazar vs Kiss / Borilački sport - MMA: Salazar vs Kiss
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Boks: Demetrius Andrade - Demond Nicholson
programme.desc: Roki Marcano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Luis. Should the more reason more to follow this noble martial skill? First traces of boxes we are already in the third century before Christ on Sumerian drawings. In the modern age, the first rules of boxes were established 18. century in London and define the combination of combat, equipment and illicit and permitted types of blows. Don't miss every opportunity to enjoy this exciting sport. / Roki Marčano, Majk Tajson, Šugar Rej Robinson, Muhamed Ali, Džo Luis. Treba li još koji razlog više da bi pratili ovu plemenitu borilačku veštinu? Prve tragove boksa nalazimo već u trećem veku pre Hrista na sumeranskim crtežima. U modernom dobu prva pravila boksa ustanovljena su 18. veku u Londonu i definišu prostor borbe, opremu te nedozvoljene i dozvoljene vrste udaraca. Ne propustite svaku priliku da uživate u ovom uzbudljivom sportu.

programme.title: Martial Sport - MMA: Jeanguillaume vs Boraros / Borilački sport - MMA: Jeanguillaume vs Boraros
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Martial Sport - MMA: Rasim Pale Vs Bayram / Borilački sport - MMA: Rasim Pala vs Bayram
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Fudbal - Copa Libertadores: Quito - Sao Paulo
programme.desc: The Copa Libertadores is an annual competition founded in 1960. year and the 38 best teams of South America occur. Throughout history, the format of the competition has changed, of which only the champions in their league have the right to date until today when each state gives a minimum of three representatives. The most successful club with the most won titles is Argentine's giant independence. Argentina also gave the most wins of Kope. The competition has iconic status and is considered one of the suburbs of soccer events on the planet. / Copa Libertadores je godišnje takmičenje osnovano 1960. godine te u njemu nastupa 38 najboljih ekipa Južne Amerike. Kroz istoriju format takmičenja se menjao, od toga da samo prvaci u svojim liga imaju pravo nastupa pa do danas kada svaka država daje po minimalno tri predstavnika. Najuspešniji klub sa najviše osvojenih titula je argentinski velikan Indipendijente. Argentina je dala i najviše osvajača Kope. Takmičenje ima ikonski status te se smatra jednim od nauzbudljivih fudbalskih događaja na planeti.

programme.title: American Football - NFL: Buffalo Bills - Miami Dolphins / Američki fudbal - NFL: Buffalo Bills - Miami Dolphins
programme.desc: The largest and most popular NFL football league was founded in 1920. years, but by merging with competing AFL in the middle of the last century, the present version of the competition was created. The league performs 32 teams divided into two conferences. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The top six teams conferencing enters the playoff to the Great Final, popularly called superbol. The superbol is played in early February and is the most probable sports event on the planet. / Najveća i najpopularnija liga američkog fudbala na svetu NFL osnovana je 1920. godine, ali tek spajanjem s konkurentskim AFL-om sredinom prošloga veka, stvorena je današnja verzija takmičenja. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podeljene u dve konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plejof do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football - French League: Lyon - Angers / Fudbal - Francuska liga: Lyon - Angers

programme.title: They live for football / Oni žive za fudbal
programme.desc: The show for all lovers of this sport, which are fed up with industrial, high-cost football, for those who are a lot of tacticals and games without goals. programme.title: Football - Mozzart Bet Superliga: Radnik - Radnicki 1923 / Fudbal - Mozzart Bet Superliga: Radnik - Radnički 1923
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the sub-circuit principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the Red-White Titles to the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcioniše po dvokružnom principu takmičenju. Istoriju Superlige u najvećoj meri su obeležila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Istorijski gledano, po broju osvojenih titula crveno-beli do grada je uspešniji.

programme.title: Basketball - KLS: Joker - Zlatiibor / Košarka - KLS: Joker - Zlatibor
programme.desc: Serbia has its first basketball league as the highest rank of professional basketball in that country. The League itself was founded in 2006. and as such as 14 teams. The competition takes place according to the subcircular point system and in mutual meetings each club hosts one time and by one guest. It is interesting in this part of the competition, Serbian clubs playing in this part of the competition, which play the regional ABA league. After the first part of the four best clubs are placed in the Super League in which clubs that played a regional competition are placed only then and in that phase, the Champions of Serbia is decided. The number of clubs that will be placed in the Super League depends on the number of representatives in the regional league, but in that part of the competition, there are always 8 teams. / Srbija ima svoju prvu košarkašku ligu kao najviši rang profesionalne košarke u toj zemlji. Sama liga osnovana je 2006. godine i kao takva broji 14 timova. Takmičenje se odvija po dvokružnom bod sistemu te je u međusobnim susretima svaki klub jedan put domaćin i po jednom gost. Zanimljivost je što u ovom delu takmičenja ne nastupaju i srpski klubovi koji igraju regionalnu ABA ligu. Nakon prvog dela četiri najbolja kluba se plasiraju u Superligu u kojoj se tek tada priključuju klubovi koji su igrali regionalno takmičenje i u toj fazi se odlučuje o prvaku Srbije. Broj klubova koji će se plasirati u Superligu zavisi o broju predstavnika u regionalnoj ligi, no u tom delu takmičenja se uvek nalazi 8 timova.

programme.title: Football - Champions League: Multiprenos / Fudbal - Liga šampiona: Multiprenos
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, the annual continental competition in which only the champions of their states are performed. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of its state. The Champions League finals became a television the most watched football event on the planet. The most conquered titles of the Champions of Europe has Madrid Giant Real. / Na predlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga šampiona, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Evrope. Plasman u Ligu šampiona klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom na ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige šampiona postalo je televizijski najgledaniji fudbalski događaj na planeti. Najviše osvojenih titula prvaka Evrope ima madridski velikan Real.

programme.title: Football - Europa League / Fudbal - Liga Evrope
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFE since 1971. years. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972. for the UEFA Cup final by the Italian artist Bertoni and each year is awarded to the winner who keeps him a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko fudbalsko takmičenje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Evropske fudbalske federacije UEFE od 1971. godine. programme.title: Hockey - KHL: Lokomotiv - tractor / Hokej - KHL: Lokomotiv - Traktor
programme.desc: The strongest hockey hockey competition in Europe and Asia is called KHL or a continental hockey league. Only the competition was created from the Russian Super League in 2008. And since then the competition is spreading to increasingly European and Asian countries and thus becomes an unofficial other Hockey League of the world after the American-Canadian NLA. At the end of the season, the winner of the KHL Plejofa received a prestigious Gagarin Cup, while the best placed the Russian team wins the title of Russia Champions. Since 2011. The League except the clubs from the former USSR includes clubs from Central Europe, while since 2016. One Chinese representative enters first. / Najjače hokejaško takmičenje u hokeju na području Evrope i Azije zove se KHL ili Kontinentalna Hokejaška Liga. Samo takmičenje je nastalo iz ruske Superlige 2008. godine i od tada se takmičenje širi na sve više evropskih i azijskih zemalja i tako postaje neslužbeno druga najbolja hokejaška liga sveta nakon američko-kanadskog NHLa. Na kraju sezone pobednik KHL plejofa dobija prestižni Gagarin Kup, dok najbolje plasirana Ruska ekipa osvaja titulu šampiona Rusije. Od 2011. ligu osim klubova iz bivšeg SSSR-a ulaze klubovi iz centralne Evrope, dok od 2016. po prvi put ulazi i jedan Kineski predstavnik.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB League: Zenit - Parma, G1 / Košarka - VTB liga: Zenit - Parma, G1
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. With the dominant Russian clubs in the league, clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakh and Latvia are also attended. Through the history of the League launched in 2008. More clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine were also involved. Starting from the season 2013-204. The VTB League is also the national championship for Russian clubs, from which the champion of Russia becomes best. In order for clubs to access the league must have a minimum capacity hall for 3000 viewers. The name of the VTB league comes from the General Sponsor of the League of the VTB Bank. FIBA Europe is 2013 officially recognized the league. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Severne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Belorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Majke šampioni
programme.desc: In the six semi-municipal episodes, the interlocutors were mothers of large, trophy athletes who, everyone in their own way, marked the history of sports of these areas. Through what difficulties and waivers are the parents face when it is necessary to see the talent of your children? What's the moment, when you see in which direction they move their lives? How long does it take to make dreams come true, and how much to never come to these achievements? Unfortunately, during the series for TV Arena, the sport will also talk to the mother who was awarded the largest world tragedy, the loss of the child. About the deaths of their sons, the strengths were forces to talk mothers Dražen Petrović and Haris Brkić. Lifebers, laughter and tears, strong emotions would describe the six episodes of the series in which their lives and parenting represented Mothers of Novak Djokovic, Jelena Brooks, Luka Jovića, as well as mothers of the tragicly killed Drazen Petrovic and Haris Brkić. / U šest polusatnih epizoda sagovornice su bile majke velikih, trofejnih sportista koji su, svako na svoj način, obeležili istoriju sporta ovih prostora. Kroz kakve teškoće i odricanja se suočavaju roditelji kada je neophodno ispratiti talenat svoje dece? Koji je to trenutak, kada vidite u kom pravcu kreću njihovi životi? Koliko je potrebno da se snovi ostvare, a koliko da do tih ostvarenja nikada ni ne dođe? Nažalost, tokom serijala za TV Arena sport govoriće i majke koje je zadesila najveća ovozemaljska tragedija, gubitak deteta. O pogibijama svojih sinova smogle su snage da pričaju majke Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića. Životni ringišpil, smeh i suze, snažne emocije… tako bi u najkraćem opisali šest epizoda serijala u kojima su svoje živote i roditeljstvo predstavile majke Novaka Đokovića, Ivane Španović, Jelene Bruks, Luke Jovića kao i majke tragično nastradalih Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Buducnost - Cibona / Košarka - ABA liga: Buducnost - Cibona
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Majke šampioni
programme.desc: In the six semi-municipal episodes, the interlocutors were mothers of large, trophy athletes who, everyone in their own way, marked the history of sports of these areas. Through what difficulties and waivers are the parents face when it is necessary to see the talent of your children? What's the moment, when you see in which direction they move their lives? How long does it take to make dreams come true, and how much to never come to these achievements? Unfortunately, during the series for TV Arena, the sport will also talk to the mother who was awarded the largest world tragedy, the loss of the child. About the deaths of their sons, the strengths were forces to talk mothers Dražen Petrović and Haris Brkić. Lifebers, laughter and tears, strong emotions would describe the six episodes of the series in which their lives and parenting represented Mothers of Novak Djokovic, Jelena Brooks, Luka Jovića, as well as mothers of the tragicly killed Drazen Petrovic and Haris Brkić. / U šest polusatnih epizoda sagovornice su bile majke velikih, trofejnih sportista koji su, svako na svoj način, obeležili istoriju sporta ovih prostora. Kroz kakve teškoće i odricanja se suočavaju roditelji kada je neophodno ispratiti talenat svoje dece? Koji je to trenutak, kada vidite u kom pravcu kreću njihovi životi? Koliko je potrebno da se snovi ostvare, a koliko da do tih ostvarenja nikada ni ne dođe? Nažalost, tokom serijala za TV Arena sport govoriće i majke koje je zadesila najveća ovozemaljska tragedija, gubitak deteta. O pogibijama svojih sinova smogle su snage da pričaju majke Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića. Životni ringišpil, smeh i suze, snažne emocije… tako bi u najkraćem opisali šest epizoda serijala u kojima su svoje živote i roditeljstvo predstavile majke Novaka Đokovića, Ivane Španović, Jelene Bruks, Luke Jovića kao i majke tragično nastradalih Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića.

programme.title: Oni vole Srbiju
programme.desc: The number of players and coaches who found its happiness in Serbia is not small. They belong to different branches of sports, and they could have been convinced here how true the famous Serbian hospitality stories are true. What is their attitude towards Serbia and what their life is, find out in our show. / Broj igrača i trenera koji je svoju sreću pronašao u Srbiji nije mali. Oni pripadaju različitim granama sporta, a ovde su mogli da se uvere koliko su priče o čuvenom srpskom gostoprimstvu istinite. Neki od njih su ovde pronašli ljubav svog života, pronašli kumove, prijatelje za ceo život, dobili državljanstvo. programme.title: Football: Wwin Liga BiH: Zrinjski - Sarajevo / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Zrinjski - Sarajevo
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Nogomet (M): Freiburg - Stuttgart, Bundesliga 2025/2026, Freiburga / Nogomet (M): Freiburg - Stuttgart, Bundesliga 2025/2026 , Freiburg
programme.desc: With all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga proudly stands. In the highest rank of a football competition founded in 1963, 18 teams compete, starting matches for a popular plate every year in August. It was most often won by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The cheerleading culture, full of tribes and top football is what Bundesliga adorns from its beginnings to the present day. Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy the Bundesliga matches. You will definitely not be sorry. / Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. V najvišjem rangu nogometnega tekmovanja, ustanovljenega leta 1963, se pomeri 18 ekip, ki vsako leto v avgustu pričnejo tekme za priljubljeni krožnik. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Mura, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Mura, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Nogomet (M): B. Munchen - HSV, Bundesliga 2025/2026
programme.desc: With all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga proudly stands. In the highest rank of a football competition founded in 1963, 18 teams compete, starting matches for a popular plate every year in August. It was most often won by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The cheerleading culture, full of tribes and top football is what Bundesliga adorns from its beginnings to the present day. Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy the Bundesliga matches. You will definitely not be sorry. / Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. V najvišjem rangu nogometnega tekmovanja, ustanovljenega leta 1963, se pomeri 18 ekip, ki vsako leto v avgustu pričnejo tekme za priljubljeni krožnik. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. Ne zamudite priložnosti, da uživate v tekmah Bundeslige. Zagotovo vam ne bo žal.

programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Mura, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Mura, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Mura, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Mura, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Freemasons, thorn in the fifth dictators, Italian documentary series, 2/2, Mon. / Prostozidarji, trn v peti diktatorjev, italijanska dokumentarna serija, 2/2, pon.
programme.sub-title: Dictators Nightmare; The Freemasonry Brotherhood was officially established in the early 18th century in London, and according to some, it existed much earlier. The work of this organization has always been wrapped in a veil of mystery. Documentary / Dictators Nightmare; Prostozidarska bratovščina je bila uradno ustanovljena na začetku 18. stoletja v Londonu, po nekaterih podatkih pa je obstajala že veliko prej. Delovanje te organizacije je že od nekdaj zavito v tančico skrivnosti. Dokumentarna seri
programme.desc: Part 2: Of the three major European dictators of the 20th century - Mussolini, Franz and Hitler - the German Firer was the one who persecuted Freemasons the most fervent. It began with the search for the culprits for the defeat of Germany in World War I. Already during the failed Hitler coup in 1923, Jews and Freemasons were proclaimed racial enemies of the German nation, and Hitler mentioned in his work my struggle a Jewish-Post-Inspiration. In 1935 he closed the German Freemasonry Lodge, and continued the persecution of Brotherhood members during World War II, not only in Germany, but also in occupied countries, including France and Belgium. After the occupation of Paris, the Nazis destroyed the main French Freemasonry Lodge. Thousands of Freemasons ended in concentration camps, where they sought to preserve their customs and secret rituals.Dictators Nightmare / Italy / 2022 / Director: Luigi Maria Perotti. / 2. del:Od treh velikih evropskih diktatorjev 20. stoletja – Mussolinija, Franca in Hitlerja – je bil nemški firer tisti, ki je prostozidarje preganjal najbolj zagrizeno. Začelo se je z iskanjem krivcev za poraz Nemčije v prvi svetovni vojni. Že v času spodletelega Hitlerjevega puča leta 1923 so Jude in prostozidarje razglasili za rasne sovražnike nemškega naroda, Hitler pa je v svojem delu Moj boj omenil judovsko-prostozidarsko zaroto. Leta 1935 je dal zapreti nemške prostozidarske lože, preganjanje članov bratovščine pa je nadaljeval tudi med drugo svetovno vojno, ne le v Nemčiji, temveč tudi v zasedenih državah, med drugim v Franciji in Belgiji. Po zasedbi Pariza so nacisti razdejali poslopje glavne francoske prostozidarske lože. Na tisoče prostozidarjev je končalo v koncentracijskih taboriščih, kjer so si prizadevali ohraniti svoje običaje in skrivne obrede.DICTATORS NIGHTMARE / Italija / 2022 / Režija: Luigi Maria Perotti.

programme.title: Jazz a lestudi
programme.desc: A space that is a blow to the jazz landscape and its variants in Catalonia. One of the key elements of this musical program is that it allows to see artists such as Dani Nel·lo, Raimundo Amador and Horacio Fumero in their natural fields: the studies of Gravation. / Espai que fa un cop dull al panorama del jazz i les seves variants a Catalunya. Un dels elements clau daquest programa musical es que permet veure artistes com Dani Nel·lo, Raimundo Amador i Horacio Fumero en el seus àmbits naturals: els estudis de gravacio.

programme.title: News 3/24 / Notícies 3/24
programme.desc: Review of the latest news Catalan, Spanish and international. programme.title: Els matins
programme.desc: TV3 daily morning macroprogram presented by journalist Ariadna Oltra. Lespai includes reports, interviews, social gatherings and debates. / Macroprograma matinal diari de TV3 que presenta la periodista Ariadna Oltra. Lespai inclou reportatges, entrevistes, tertúlies i debats.

programme.title: Tot es soft / Tot es mou
programme.desc: Helena Garcia Melero leads this daily magazine that follows lactuality, gives voice to the protagonists of the moment and deals with those who play more closely by citizens with a kind and distracted tone. / Helena Garcia Melero condueix aquest magazín diari que segueix lactualitat, dona veu als protagonistes del moment i tracta aquelles questions que toquen mes de prop els ciutadans amb un to amable i distret.

programme.title: Telenotícies comarques
programme.desc: Daily news, directed and presented by Núria Sole, with local and regional information that values ​​the voice of the street, the testimonies and the protagonists of the news. TN Comarques explains and reflects the reality of the towns and cities of Catalonia. / Informatiu diari, dirigit i presentat per Núria Sole, amb informacio local i comarcal que posa en valor la veu del carrer, els testimonis i els protagonistes de la notícia. TN Comarques explica i reflecteix la realitat dels pobles i ciutats de Catalunya.

programme.title: Telenotícies migdia
programme.desc: Daily news that includes the most prominent events of lactuality, collected by the TVC news services, with the support of the chronicles and connections with the correspondents and special envoys around the world. / Informatiu diari que inclou els esdeveniments mes destacats de lactualitat, recollits pels serveis informatius de TVC, amb el suport de les cròniques i les connexions amb els corresponsals i enviats especials arreu del mon.

programme.title: Cuines
programme.desc: Space in which chef Marc Ribas offers recipes that everyone can make and with easy -to -find ingredients. In addition, the program features the Council the Council in which Ribas explains curiosities of products and tricks to know how to buy better. / Espai en el qual el cuiner Marc Ribas ofereix receptes que tothom pot fer i amb ingredients fàcils de trobar. A mes, el programa compta amb la seccio el consell en la que Ribas explica curiositats dels productes i trucs per saber comprar millor.

programme.title: As if it were yesterday / Com si fos ahir
programme.desc: A group of Dantics Companys Outittites, after twenty-five years, meet at the funeral dun dells. The Institute's time made them a heterogeneous, gamber and full of life group, but life was distributed very diverse to TV3 on the table, after the end of the creek, which was broadcast for eight seasons. As if it were yesterday it runs in Barcelona and the protagonists live throughout the geography of the city. The series, starring Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Labyrinth of Shadows), Montse Germán (Infidels) and Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), wants to present everyday life that can sometimes be raw, sometimes pathetic, but which can also be tender, light and even fun. / Una colla dantics companys dinstitut es retroben, despres de vint-i-cinc anys, al funeral dun dells. Lèpoca de linstitut els va convertir en un grup heterogeni, gamberro i ple de vida, però la vida els va anar repartint fitxes molt diverses.Nova aposta de TV3 per la sobretaula, despres del final de La Riera, que es va emetre durant vuit temporades. Com si fos ahir transcorre a Barcelona i els protagonistes viuen repartits per tota la geografia de la ciutat. La sèrie, protagonitzada per Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d’ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) i Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), vol presentar una quotidianitat que de vegades pot ser crua, de vegades patètica, però que tambe pot ser tendra, lleugera i, fins i tot, divertida.

programme.title: The paradise of the ladies / El paraíso de las señoras
programme.desc: Treaty by her boyfriend, Teresa Sen goes from village and flees to the big city. There he discovers that his uncle's shop goes through difficulty due to the opening of the paradise of the ladies. / Traïda pel seu xicot, Teresa sen va de poble i fuig a la gran ciutat. Allà descobreix que la botiga del seu oncle passa per dificultats a causa de lobertura duns grans magatzems El Paradís de les Senyores.

programme.title: The jungle: episodi 7 / La selva: Episodi 7
programme.desc: Xavier Grasset presents this afternoon magazine in which a day of the day is a relaxed way. A meeting full of knowledge and monitoring of the events of the day, but also with very deDrettement and with several collaborators. / Xavier Grasset presenta aquest magazín de tardes en el que es fa un repàs a lactualitat del dia de forma distesa. Una trobada plena de coneixement i seguiment dels fets del dia, però tambe amb molt dentreteniment i amb diversos col·laboradors.

programme.title: Atrpam Si Pots: Episodi 162 / Atrapam si pots: Episodi 162
programme.desc: Llucià Ferrer presents this Question and Answer Contest in which six contestants compete to win the jar. The questions cover the whole field of knowledge, focus on curiosities and use word games and riddles. / Llucià Ferrer presenta aquest concurs de preguntes i respostes en què sis concursants competeixen per guanyar el pot. Les preguntes abasten tot el camp del coneixement, se centren en curiositats i fan ús de jocs de paraules i endevinalles.

programme.title: Is happening: episode 7 / Està passant: Episodi 7
programme.desc: Satirical information presented by Òscar Andreu, Jair Dominguez, Natza Farre and Queco Novell, which analyzes the keys to the lactuality of the day. The space also gives voice to experts to give their opinion on the lactuality and interview their main protagonists. / Informatiu satíric presentat per Òscar Andreu, Jair Dominguez, Natza Farre i Queco Novell, que analitza les claus de lactualitat del dia. Lespai tambe dona veu a experts perquè donin la seva opinio sobre lactualitat i entrevista els seus principals protagonistes.
